weapons.name: F Bone Wedge
weapons.description: A traditional cutting weapon favored by Felynes. Sturdy bone is used in the head.
weapons.description_de: Traditionelle, von Felynen bevorzugte Schneidewaffe mit Knochen im Kopfteil.
weapons.description_fr: Arme traditionnelle prisée des Felynes. Extrémité tranchante en os solide.
weapons.description_es: Arma cortante tradicional, preferida por los Felyne. El extremo es muy resistente.
weapons.description_it: Arma da taglio tradizionale dei Felyne, la cui sommità è ricavata da osso robusto.
weapons.description_zh: A traditional cutting weapon favored by Felynes. Sturdy bone is used in the head.

weapons.name: F Bherna Staff
weapons.description: A Palico weapon with a bell that can control Moofahs. Great for hiking.
weapons.description_de: Eine Kameradenwaffe mit einer Glocke, die Muufahs kontrolliert. Gut im Gebirge.
weapons.description_fr: Arme de Palico munie d'une clochette capable de contrôler les Moofah. Utile en montagne.
weapons.description_es: Arma de camarada con campanilla capaz de controlar Moofah. Genial para ir de excursión.
weapons.description_it: Arma per compagni con una campana che permette di controllare i Moofah. Utile in montagna.
weapons.description_zh: A Palico weapon with a bell that can control Moofahs. Great for hiking.

weapons.name: F Iron Sword
weapons.description: A product of quality ore and three nights of labor. Sharp, or your money back.
weapons.description_de: In drei Arbeitsnächten aus hochwertigem Erz gefertigt. Nicht scharf? Geld zurück!
weapons.description_fr: Fabriquée en trois nuits à base de minerai de qualité. Tranchant garanti.
weapons.description_es: Mineral de calidad y tres noches de trabajo. Afilada, o le devolvemos el dinero.
weapons.description_it: Ricavata da ferro pregiato in tre notti di lavoro. Affilatura garantita.
weapons.description_zh: A product of quality ore and three nights of labor. Sharp, or your money back.

weapons.name: F Bone Hammer
weapons.description: A light yet durable hammer slapped together from easy- to-find bones.
weapons.description_de: Ein leichter, aber stabiler Hammer; aus jederzeit zu findenden Knochen gefertigt.
weapons.description_fr: Marteau à base d'os communs. À la fois léger et solide.
weapons.description_es: Un martillo ligero a la par que resistente, hecho de huesos comunes.
weapons.description_it: Martello leggero e robusto, realizzato fissando insieme ossa di facile reperibilità.
weapons.description_zh: A light yet durable hammer slapped together from easy- to-find bones.

weapons.name: F Jaggi Knife
weapons.description: A small blade made of common Great Jaggi Scraps. Weak, but a cinch to use.
weapons.description_de: Kleine Klinge aus einfachen Großjaggi-Teilen. Schwach, aber leicht zu handhaben.
weapons.description_fr: Petite lame fabriquée à base de Grand Jaggi. Faible, mais très facile à manier.
weapons.description_es: Pequeña hoja hecha de restos de Gran Jaggi común. Débil, pero fácil de usar.
weapons.description_it: Spadino ricavato da parti comuni di Gran Jaggi. Poco incisivo, ma maneggevole.
weapons.description_zh: A small blade made of common Great Jaggi Scraps. Weak, but a cinch to use.

weapons.name: F Hunting Knife
weapons.description: Kokoto's iconic weapon, retrofitted for Palico use. A staple hunting item.
weapons.description_de: Kokotos Markenzeichen, für Kameraden nachgerüstet; ein Standardobjekt für die Jagd.
weapons.description_fr: Arme emblématique de Kokoto modernisée pour les Palicos. Tout bon Miaroudeur a le sien.
weapons.description_es: Arma emblemática de Kokoto, modernizada para los camaradas. Todo buen cazador tiene una.
weapons.description_it: L'arma tipica di Kokoto, adattata ai compagni. Ogni buon cacciatore ne possiede uno.
weapons.description_zh: Kokoto's iconic weapon, retrofitted for Palico use. A staple hunting item.

weapons.name: F Yukumo Bokken
weapons.description: A wooden sword carved from strong Yukumo trees. Dishes out some nasty lumps.
weapons.description_de: Ein starkes Schwert aus Yukumo-Holz. Es verursacht schmerzhafte Beulen.
weapons.description_fr: Épée taillée dans le bois dur des arbres de Yukumo. Donne de vilaines bosses.
weapons.description_es: Espada hecha con la madera de robustos árboles de Yukumo. Llena de chichones al rival.
weapons.description_it: Spada di legno ricavata dai fusti dei possenti alberi di Yukumo. Davvero temibile.
weapons.description_zh: A wooden sword carved from strong Yukumo trees. Dishes out some nasty lumps.

weapons.name: F Wood Chopper
weapons.description: A Palico axe sharp enough to cut anything. Used for wood cutting practice in Yukumo.
weapons.description_de: Diese scharfe Kameradenaxt kann durch alles schneiden... und sogar Holz hacken!
weapons.description_fr: Hache de Palico qui coupe tout. Utilisée pour apprendre à couper le bois à Yukumo.
weapons.description_es: Hacha de camaradas muy afilada capaz de cortarlo todo. Se usa para cortar leña en Yukumo.
weapons.description_it: Ascia per compagni in grado di affettare qualunque cosa. Usata a Yukumo per tagliare la legna.
weapons.description_zh: A Palico axe sharp enough to cut anything. Used for wood cutting practice in Yukumo.

weapons.name: F Paw Punch
weapons.description: A customary blunt weapon favored by Felynes. Sturdy wood is used in the head.
weapons.description_de: Eine übliche, von Felynen bevorzugte Hiebwaffe. Der Kopf ist aus stabilem Holz.
weapons.description_fr: Arme contondante prisée des Felynes. La patte est composée de bois solide.
weapons.description_es: Arma contundente tradicional preferida por los Felyne. Extremo de madera robusta.
weapons.description_it: Arma speciale dei Felyne, la cui sommità è ricavata da legno robusto.
weapons.description_zh: A customary blunt weapon favored by Felynes. Sturdy wood is used in the head.

weapons.name: F Alta Net
weapons.description: A Bug Net cleverly reworked for offense. Insects fear the sight of it.
weapons.description_de: Ein Käfernetz, für den Angriff umfunktioniert. Insekten erzittern bei seinem Anblick.
weapons.description_fr: Ingénieusement repensé pour l'attaque, ce filet est redouté par les insectes.
weapons.description_es: Mosquitera astutamente alterada para el ataque. Los insectos se asustan con solo mirarla.
weapons.description_it: Un retino ingegnosamente modificato a scopo offensivo. Molto temuto dagli insetti.
weapons.description_zh: A Bug Net cleverly reworked for offense. Insects fear the sight of it.

weapons.name: F Rheno Hammer
weapons.description: A hammer crafted by fusing metal to Rhenoplos Scraps. Wieldier than it looks.
weapons.description_de: Ein Hammer aus Metall und Rhenoplos-Teilen. Handlicher als er aussieht.
weapons.description_fr: Fait d'un alliage de métal et de Rhenoplos. Plus facile à manier qu'il n'en a l'air.
weapons.description_es: Martillo hecho con metal y restos de Rhenoplos. No es muy difícil de blandir.
weapons.description_it: Ottenuto fondendo metallo con resti di Rhenoplos. Più agile di quanto appaia.
weapons.description_zh: A hammer crafted by fusing metal to Rhenoplos Scraps. Wieldier than it looks.

weapons.name: F Bnaha Dagger
weapons.description: A thin-bladed, vibrant knife resembling a feather. Sharp enough to cut the wind.
weapons.description_de: Eine Klinge, dünn wie eine Feder, scharf genug, den Wind zu schneiden.
weapons.description_fr: Joli couteau à fine lame ressemblant à une plume. Capable de trancher le vent.
weapons.description_es: Cuchillo radiante de hoja fina similar a una pluma. Tan afilado que podría cortar el viento.
weapons.description_it: Coltello sottile e agile come una piuma. È tanto affilato da tagliare il vento.
weapons.description_zh: A thin-bladed, vibrant knife resembling a feather. Sharp enough to cut the wind.

weapons.name: F Maccao Dagger
weapons.description: A dagger made from Maccao Scraps. Its pommel feathers are especially eye-catching.
weapons.description_de: Ein Dolch, hergestellt aus Maccao-Resten. Die Federn am Knauf sehen toll aus.
weapons.description_fr: Faite à partir de débris de Maccao. Les plumes de son pommeau interrogent le regard.
weapons.description_es: Daga hecha con restos de Maccao. Su puño de plumas es especialmente llamativo.
weapons.description_it: Pugnale ricavato da scarti di Maccao. Le piume sul manico sono molto vistose.
weapons.description_zh: A dagger made from Maccao Scraps. Its pommel feathers are especially eye-catching.

weapons.name: F Vprey Bayonet
weapons.description: A gun-shaped bayonet with a cute checkered pattern. Despite its appearance, it can't fire.
weapons.description_de: Gewehrförmiges Bajonett mit süßem Kästchenmuster. Kann aber trotzdem nicht schießen.
weapons.description_fr: Ornée d'un joli motif en damier, cette arme ne tire aucun projectile malgré son apparence.
weapons.description_es: Bayoneta en forma de pistola con bello estampado a cuadros. Pese a su aspecto, no dispara.
weapons.description_it: Baionetta a forma di pistola decorata a scacchi. Nonostante l'aspetto, non può sparare.
weapons.description_zh: A gun-shaped bayonet with a cute checkered pattern. Despite its appearance, it can't fire.

weapons.name: F Bulldrome Tusk
weapons.description: A hammer that slams into prey as hard as a Bulldrome. Each swing smells beastly.
weapons.description_de: Dieser Hammer rammt Beute so hart wie ein Bulldrome. Sein Schwung riecht bestialisch.
weapons.description_fr: Heurte ses proies avec la force d'un Bulldrome. Dégage une odeur bestiale.
weapons.description_es: Un martillo que embiste a la presa con la fuerza de un Bulldrome. Huele a bestia.
weapons.description_it: Martello che si abbatte sulla preda con la forza e l'olezzo di un Bulldrome.
weapons.description_zh: A hammer that slams into prey as hard as a Bulldrome. Each swing smells beastly.

weapons.name: F Arzuros Mace
weapons.description: A weapon made by condensing Arzuros shells for rigidity. Hits as hard as a real Arzy.
weapons.description_de: Stabile Waffe aus verdichte- ten Arzuros-Panzern. Schlägt so hart wie das Original.
weapons.description_fr: En carapace compressée pour une rigidité optimale. Cogne aussi fort que le vrai Arzy.
weapons.description_es: Un arma hecha con una amalgama de corazas de Arzuros. Golpea tan fuerte como uno vivo.
weapons.description_it: Arma rinforzata condensando gusci di Arzuros. Colpisce con la potenza di un Arzy.
weapons.description_zh: A weapon made by condensing Arzuros shells for rigidity. Hits as hard as a real Arzy.

weapons.name: F Genprey Bayonet
weapons.description: A soldier's best close-range friend, now for Palicoes. So what if it can't fire?
weapons.description_de: Der beste Freund des Soldaten, auf kurze Distanz. Jetzt für Kameraden, nur ohne Schießen.
weapons.description_fr: La fidèle arme du soldat, dans sa version pour Palico. Ne tire aucun projectile, et alors ?
weapons.description_es: Arma ideal de corto alcance para soldados y ahora para camaradas. ¿Qué más da que no dispare?
weapons.description_it: Arma da mischia per soldati, ora anche per compagni. E poco importa se non può sparare.
weapons.description_zh: A soldier's best close-range friend, now for Palicoes. So what if it can't fire?

weapons.name: F Cephalos Brush
weapons.description: A neat freak's dream weapon. Dusty monster got you down? Break out this brush!
weapons.description_de: Traumwaffe jedes Putzteufels! Rücken dir staubige Monster auf die Pelle? Besen raus!
weapons.description_fr: Arme pour maniaque. Vous avez mordu la poussière ? Cette brosse est pour vous !
weapons.description_es: Cepillo para maniáticos de la limpieza. ¿Que tienes un monstruo sucio? ¡A por él!
weapons.description_it: L'arma preferita dai patiti dell'igiene. Dai una ripulita a quei mostri sporcaccioni!
weapons.description_zh: A neat freak's dream weapon. Dusty monster got you down? Break out this brush!

weapons.name: F Machalite Wedge
weapons.description: A traditional Felyne weapon that uses ore for a sharper cutting edge.
weapons.description_de: Traditionelle Felyne-Waffe, die Erz für eine schärfere Schnittkante einsetzt.
weapons.description_fr: Arme Felyne traditionnelle à base de minerai pour un fil plus tranchant.
weapons.description_es: Un arma tradicional Felyne que utiliza el mineral para dar una hoja más afilada.
weapons.description_it: Arma Felyne tradizionale con una lama resa affilata dal minerale usato.
weapons.description_zh: A traditional Felyne weapon that uses ore for a sharper cutting edge.

weapons.name: F Giant Acorn
weapons.description: A heavy blunt weapon that takes a hollowed-out acorn and packs it with wood.
weapons.description_de: Eine massive, stumpfe Waffe. Besteht aus einer ausgehöhlten Eichel, gefüllt mit Holz.
weapons.description_fr: Arme lourde faite à partir d'une châtaigne évidée puis remplie de bois.
weapons.description_es: Arma contundente sin filo que recoge una bellota hueca y la rellena de madera.
weapons.description_it: Grossa arma contundente ottenuta svuotando una ghianda e riempiendola di legno.
weapons.description_zh: A heavy blunt weapon that takes a hollowed-out acorn and packs it with wood.

weapons.name: F Stone Cat Statue
weapons.description: A precious Felyne relic repurposed for hunting. Your Palico will hate you.
weapons.description_de: Diese Waffe wurde aus einem Felyne-Relikt hergestellt. Dein Kamerad wird dich hassen.
weapons.description_fr: Précieuse relique Felyne recyclée en arme de chasse. Votre Palico va vous détester.
weapons.description_es: Una valiosa reliquia Felyne remodelada para la caza. Tu camarada te odiará si la usas.
weapons.description_it: Una preziosa reliquia Felyne adattata alla caccia. Il tuo compagno ti odierà.
weapons.description_zh: A precious Felyne relic repurposed for hunting. Your Palico will hate you.

weapons.name: F Venombee Bat
weapons.description: A scary bat where one swing dispenses stingers aplenty. Keep it out of the ball game!
weapons.description_de: Ein schauriger Schläger, der es ordentlich krachen lässt. Nicht für Ballspiele geeignet.
weapons.description_fr: Batte effrayante propageant une multitude de dards à chaque coup. Interdite sur les terrains !
weapons.description_es: Aterrador bate que lanza muchos aguijones con cada golpe. ¡No lo lleves a un partido!
weapons.description_it: Terribile mazza che dispensa dolore al primo fendente. Non usarla sui campi di gioco!
weapons.description_zh: A scary bat where one swing dispenses stingers aplenty. Keep it out of the ball game!

weapons.name: F Gourmet Cheese
weapons.description: An all too appetizing hammer made from fragrant cheese by the Gourmew Chef.
weapons.description_de: Ein appetitlicher Hammer, geformt aus duftendem Käse, hergestellt vom Gourmiau-Koch persönlich.
weapons.description_fr: Marteau très appétissant préparé par le chef Gourmiaou avec du bon fromage.
weapons.description_es: Martillo de lo más apetitoso hecho por el Chef Gourmiau con un queso aromático.
weapons.description_it: Appetitoso martello ottenuto lavorando il formaggio prelibato dello chef Gourmiao.
weapons.description_zh: An all too appetizing hammer made from fragrant cheese by the Gourmew Chef.

weapons.name: F Moofah Cotton
weapons.description: A weapon made from just enough Moofah cotton to knit a Palico sweater.
weapons.description_de: Eine Waffe aus genau der Menge Muufah-Flausch, die für einen Kameraden-Pullover nötig ist.
weapons.description_fr: Arme faite avec assez de coton de Moofah pour tricoter un pull pour un Palico.
weapons.description_es: Arma hecha con suficiente algodón de Moofah para tejer un jersey de camarada.
weapons.description_it: Arma realizzata con abbastanza cotone di Moofah da cucire un maglione per compagni.
weapons.description_zh: A weapon made from just enough Moofah cotton to knit a Palico sweater.

weapons.name: F Aptonoth Meat
weapons.description: A hammer forged from fresh, uncooked meat. Sadly, it's been rendered inedible.
weapons.description_de: Ein Hammer, geschmiedet aus frischem, ungekochtem Fleisch. Leider inzwischen ungenießbar.
weapons.description_fr: Marteau forgé à partir de viande fraîche et crue. Dommage, elle n'est plus comestible.
weapons.description_es: Martillo forjado a partir de carne cruda. Por desgracia, es totalmente incomestible.
weapons.description_it: Martello composto da prelibata carne cruda. Purtroppo, non è più commestibile.
weapons.description_zh: A hammer forged from fresh, uncooked meat. Sadly, it's been rendered inedible.

weapons.name: F Fish Stick
weapons.description: A primitive-looking Palico weapon made of stone. More useful than it looks.
weapons.description_de: Diese Kameradenwaffe sieht verführerisch aus, aber nimm sie bloß nicht in den Mund!
weapons.description_fr: Arme primitive de Palico faite en pierre. Plus utile qu'elle n'en a l'air.
weapons.description_es: Arma para camaradas hecha de piedra, con aspecto primitivo. Más útil de lo que parece.
weapons.description_it: Arma di pietra per compagni dall'aria primitiva. È più efficace di quanto sembri.
weapons.description_zh: A primitive-looking Palico weapon made of stone. More useful than it looks.

weapons.name: F Grilled Hammer
weapons.description: The juiciest part of the bird. Perfect for "drumming up" help from your Palicoes.
weapons.description_de: Das saftigste Vogelstück. Perfekt, um Hilfe von deinen Kameraden herbeizutrommeln.
weapons.description_fr: Le morceau le plus juteux ! Votre Palico rappliquera en vitesse pour vous aider.
weapons.description_es: Hecho con la parte más sabrosa de un ave. Ideal para que tu camarada te eche un muslo.
weapons.description_it: Succosa carne di volatile. Ideale per invocare l'aiuto dei compagni.
weapons.description_zh: The juiciest part of the bird. Perfect for "drumming up" help from your Palicoes.

weapons.name: F Ioprey Bayonet
weapons.description: The center of rumors about the future of Palico combat. Unable to shoot by design.
weapons.description_de: Angeblich der kommende Trend für Kameradenwaffen; nicht zum Schießen geeignet.
weapons.description_fr: Au centre des rumeurs sur le futur des armes pour Palicos. N'est pas conçue pour tirer.
weapons.description_es: Suscita rumores sobre el futuro bélico de los camaradas. No está diseñada para disparar.
weapons.description_it: Al centro del dibattito sul futuro delle armi per compagni. Progettata per non sparare.
weapons.description_zh: The center of rumors about the future of Palico combat. Unable to shoot by design.

weapons.name: F Lagombi Staff
weapons.description: A darling but dangerous item that launches a slab of ice with each strike.
weapons.description_de: Hübsch, aber gefährlich: Diese Waffe schleudert mit jedem Schlag eine Eisplatte.
weapons.description_fr: Adorable, mais redoutable. Projette un bloc de glace à chaque attaque.
weapons.description_es: Un objeto encantador, a la par que peligroso, que lanza carámbanos a cada golpe.
weapons.description_it: Arma elegante ma temibile che accompagna ogni fendente con una scarica di ghiaccio.
weapons.description_zh: A darling but dangerous item that launches a slab of ice with each strike.

weapons.name: F Kut-Ku Cutter
weapons.description: A grand sword made of Yian Kut-Ku Scraps. (No, it's not a fan... Stop asking.)
weapons.description_de: Grandioses Schwert aus Yian- Kut-Ku-Teilen. (Nein, es ist kein Fächer... Basta.)
weapons.description_fr: Grande épée à base de Yian Kut-Ku. Non, non... ce n'est pas un éventail.
weapons.description_es: Una gran espada hecha de restos de Yian Kut-Ku (y no, no es un abanico).
weapons.description_it: Nobile spada forgiata con resti di Yian Kut-Ku (e no, non è un ventaglio).
weapons.description_zh: A grand sword made of Yian Kut-Ku Scraps. (No, it's not a fan... Stop asking.)

weapons.name: F Gypceros Glare
weapons.description: An ancient weapon governing resurrection. Its mystic power makes fish fresh again.
weapons.description_de: Herrscht über die Wieder- auferstehung. Seine Macht macht Fisch wieder frisch.
weapons.description_fr: Arme ancienne capable de résurrection. Redonne leur fraîcheur aux poissons.
weapons.description_es: Un arma antigua que controla la resurrección. Hace que el pescado siempre esté fresco.
weapons.description_it: Arma antica che governa la resurrezione. Ha il potere di rendere fresco il pesce.
weapons.description_zh: An ancient weapon governing resurrection. Its mystic power makes fish fresh again.

weapons.name: F Cabra Pounder
weapons.description: A mighty humorous weapon that can get even the saddest kids to burst out laughing.
weapons.description_de: Eine mächtig lustige Waffe, die selbst die traurigsten Kinder zum Lachen bringt.
weapons.description_fr: Arme irrésistiblement drôle capable de faire éclater de rire les enfants les plus tristes.
weapons.description_es: Arma poderosamente cómica capaz de hacer que el niño más triste explote en carcajadas.
weapons.description_it: Arma talmente buffa che strapperebbe un sorriso anche al bambino più imbronciato.
weapons.description_zh: A mighty humorous weapon that can get even the saddest kids to burst out laughing.

weapons.name: F Daimyo Shears
weapons.description: A briny Daimyo weapon whose sturdy snips cut through even the most stubborn acorn.
weapons.description_de: Salzige Waffe aus Daimyo. Robuste Schneiden zerteilen die härtesten Eicheln.
weapons.description_fr: Arme marine dont les fermes entailles viennent à bout des châtaignes les plus coriaces.
weapons.description_es: Arma de Daimyo cuyos cortes penetran hasta las bellotas más duras.
weapons.description_it: Arma di Daimyo marino dotata di cesoie che possono tagliare anche le ghiande più dure.
weapons.description_zh: A briny Daimyo weapon whose sturdy snips cut through even the most stubborn acorn.

weapons.name: F Ludroth Paw
weapons.description: Royal Ludroth claws give this weapon a splash of Water-imbued power.
weapons.description_de: Königs-Ludroth-Klauen geben dieser Waffe einen Spritzer wasserdurchtränkter Kraft.
weapons.description_fr: Arme composée de griffes de Ludroth royal lui conférant la puissance de l'eau.
weapons.description_es: Las garras de Ludroth Real confieren al arma un toque de poder acuático.
weapons.description_it: Gli artigli di Ludroth reale infondono all'arma il potere dell'acqua.
weapons.description_zh: Royal Ludroth claws give this weapon a splash of Water-imbued power.

weapons.name: F Khezu Whaccine
weapons.description: A horrific Palico weapon that weakens targets with an electric injection.
weapons.description_de: Eine furchtbare Kameraden- Waffe, die Ziele mit einer Elektro-Injektion schwächt.
weapons.description_fr: Arme de Palico qui affaiblit ses proies avec une injection électrique.
weapons.description_es: Un arma de camarada terrible que debilita a los objetivos con una inyección eléctrica.
weapons.description_it: Tremenda arma dei compagni che sfibra il nemico con iniezioni elettriche.
weapons.description_zh: A horrific Palico weapon that weakens targets with an electric injection.

weapons.name: F Nibel Blammer
weapons.description: A former gunhammer whose firing mechanisms have been axed for easy Palico use.
weapons.description_de: Einstiger Schusshammer ohne Feuermechanismen; für Kame- raden leicht zu handhaben.
weapons.description_fr: Marteaucanon revisité pour être aisément utilisé par des Palicos.
weapons.description_es: Un antiguo martillo pistola sin mecanismos de disparo, para mayor facilidad de uso.
weapons.description_it: Martello-fucile privato del meccanismo di innesco per agevolare i compagni.
weapons.description_zh: A former gunhammer whose firing mechanisms have been axed for easy Palico use.

weapons.name: F Quest Book
weapons.description: A thick, heavy book with plenty of heft. Its real value is what's inside.
weapons.description_de: Ein dickes, schweres Buch, das ordentlich Schwung hat. Der Inhalt ist noch gefährlicher.
weapons.description_fr: Livre lourd et épais dont la valeur s'explique par ce qu'il renferme.
weapons.description_es: Libro grueso y pesado, un gran tostón. Su auténtico valor reside en el interior.
weapons.description_it: Libro grosso, pesante e molto massiccio. A renderlo prezioso sono i contenuti.
weapons.description_zh: A thick, heavy book with plenty of heft. Its real value is what's inside.

weapons.name: F Vprey Wedge
weapons.description: A traditional Felyne weapon fashioned from the talon of a small, non-native monster.
weapons.description_de: Traditionelle Felyne-Waffe aus der Kralle eines nicht einheimischen Monsters.
weapons.description_fr: Arme Felyne traditionnelle fabriquée avec la serre d'un petit monstre allogène.
weapons.description_es: Un arma tradicional Felyne hecha con la garra de un monstruo no autóctono.
weapons.description_it: Arma tradizionale Felyne ricavata dall'artiglio di un mostro non indigeno.
weapons.description_zh: A traditional Felyne weapon fashioned from the talon of a small, non-native monster.

weapons.name: F Barrel Basher
weapons.description: A big, heavy barrel turned into a weapon. Requires serious muscle to wield.
weapons.description_de: Eine Waffe aus einem großen, schweren Fass. Der Einsatz erfordert viel Muskelkraft.
weapons.description_fr: Baril lourd et volumineux utilisé comme arme. Réservé aux costauds.
weapons.description_es: Un enorme y pesado barril convertido en arma. Hace falta músculo para usarlo.
weapons.description_it: Arma ricavata da un pesante barile. Solo i più forzuti possono maneggiarla.
weapons.description_zh: A big, heavy barrel turned into a weapon. Requires serious muscle to wield.

weapons.name: F Derring Lance
weapons.description: A fine lance made of a big, hand-picked acorn. A weapon that just screams "Felyne."
weapons.description_de: Feine Lanze aus einer großen handgepflückten Eichel. Wie für eine Felyne geschaffen.
weapons.description_fr: Lance de qualité surmontée d'une grosse châtaigne. Arme typiquement "Felyne".
weapons.description_es: Lanza de calidad hecha con una bellota gigante. Arma típica de los Felyne.
weapons.description_it: Lancia realizzata con ghiande raccolte a mano, tipica dei Felyne.
weapons.description_zh: A fine lance made of a big, hand-picked acorn. A weapon that just screams "Felyne."

weapons.name: F Edel Rod
weapons.description: A weapon made of highland flowers. Its cuteness belies its offensive capabilities.
weapons.description_de: Hergestellt aus Blumen, die nur im Hochgebirge wachsen. Ebenso hübsch wie tödlich.
weapons.description_fr: Arme faite avec des fleurs des hautes terres. Cache bien ses capacités offensives.
weapons.description_es: Arma hecha con flores de las tierras altas, de aspecto tierno pero poderosa en el ataque.
weapons.description_it: Arma ricavata dai fiori degli altopiani. L'aspetto grazioso ne maschera l'efficacia.
weapons.description_zh: A weapon made of highland flowers. Its cuteness belies its offensive capabilities.

weapons.name: F Mosgharl Broom
weapons.description: A blunt weapon villagers once used to shoo monsters away. Great for tidying up!
weapons.description_de: Dorfbewohner verjagten mit dieser Hiebwaffe Monster. Toll zum Saubermachen!
weapons.description_fr: Arme jadis utilisée par les villageois pour chasser les monstres... et balayer.
weapons.description_es: Arma contundente que antaño usaban los aldeanos para espantar a los monstruos.
weapons.description_it: Arma contundente usata per scacciare i mostri. Perfetta anche per le pulizie!
weapons.description_zh: A blunt weapon villagers once used to shoo monsters away. Great for tidying up!

weapons.name: F Bushwhacker
weapons.description: A weapon with real punch when it hits. Clearly not made of ordinary wood.
weapons.description_de: Eine Waffe mit ordentlich Rumms, wenn sie trifft. Nicht aus normalem Holz.
weapons.description_fr: Avec une telle force de frappe, cette arme n'est clairement pas faite d'un bois ordinaire.
weapons.description_es: Arma que golpea con gran contundencia. Está claro que no es de madera normal.
weapons.description_it: Arma capace di infliggere colpi terrificanti. Chiaramente non ricavata da legname comune.
weapons.description_zh: A weapon with real punch when it hits. Clearly not made of ordinary wood.

weapons.name: F Death Stench Scythe
weapons.description: A ferociously sharp scythe. No monster can ward off its calls to slumber for long.
weapons.description_de: Eine schrecklich scharfe Sense, deren Lockruf kein Monster widerstehen kann.
weapons.description_fr: Faux d'un tranchant terrifiant. Aucun monstre ne peut y échapper éternellement.
weapons.description_es: Guadaña ferozmente afilada. Ningún monstruo resiste su llamada para echar un largo sueñecito.
weapons.description_it: Falce terribilmente affilata. Nessun mostro resisterà a lungo al suo richiamo mortale.
weapons.description_zh: A ferociously sharp scythe. No monster can ward off its calls to slumber for long.

weapons.name: F Marauder Blade
weapons.description: A hit with Palicoes due to the pawprint hilt. Adorable, yet imposing.
weapons.description_de: Beliebt bei Kameraden dank des Schafts mit Tatzen- abdruck. Süß und imposant.
weapons.description_fr: Les Palicos raffolent de sa garde en forme de patte. Adorable et majestueuse.
weapons.description_es: De moda entre los camaradas por la huella en la empuñadura. Impone sin perder el buen gusto.
weapons.description_it: Apprezzata dai compagni per l'impronta della zampa sopra l'elsa. Bella e terribile.
weapons.description_zh: A hit with Palicoes due to the pawprint hilt. Adorable, yet imposing.

weapons.name: F Marauder Gavel
weapons.description: A wooden hammer branded with a pawprint. Popular for its cute yet dashing design.
weapons.description_de: Ein Holzhammer mit Tatzen- abdruck. Ein niedliches, aber schneidiges Design.
weapons.description_fr: Marteau en bois marqué d'une empreinte de patte. Mignon et élégant à la fois.
weapons.description_es: Martillo de madera marcado con una huella. Popular por su diseño bonito y elegante.
weapons.description_it: Martello di legno con l'impronta di una zampa. Tenero ed elegante.
weapons.description_zh: A wooden hammer branded with a pawprint. Popular for its cute yet dashing design.

weapons.name: F Volvi Lantern
weapons.description: A weapon capable of giving its target Paralysis thanks to its Volvidon Scraps.
weapons.description_de: Eine Waffe, die dank ihrer Volvidon-Reste den Gegner lähmen kann.
weapons.description_fr: Arme capable de paralyser sa cible car élaborée à partir de débris de Volvidon.
weapons.description_es: Arma capaz de provocar parálisis gracias a sus restos de Volvidon.
weapons.description_it: Arma capace di paralizzare il bersaglio grazie agli scarti di Volvidon da cui è ricavata.
weapons.description_zh: A weapon capable of giving its target Paralysis thanks to its Volvidon Scraps.

weapons.name: F Jester Parasol
weapons.description: A curious weapon said to have hypnotic effects with the sound of every swing.
weapons.description_de: Eine merkwürdige Waffe, deren Schwung hypnotische Wirkung haben soll.
weapons.description_fr: Arme curieuse dont chaque coup distille des sons aux effets hypnotiques.
weapons.description_es: Arma muy curiosa. Cuentan que el sonido que produce al agitarlo tiene efectos hipnóticos.
weapons.description_it: Arma bizzarra che pare possa indurre effetti ipnotici con il sibilo dei suoi fendenti.
weapons.description_zh: A curious weapon said to have hypnotic effects with the sound of every swing.

weapons.name: F Rathian Rapier
weapons.description: A slender, regal sword imbued with the lovely, green Rathian's might and pride.
weapons.description_de: Ein schlankes, königliches Schwert mit Stolz und Macht der grünen Rathian.
weapons.description_fr: Épée fine renfermant la force et la fierté de la Rathian émeraude.
weapons.description_es: Fina espada regia impregnada con la fuerza y el orgullo de la Rathian.
weapons.description_it: Spada nobile e leggera che racchiude la forza e l'orgoglio Rathian.
weapons.description_zh: A slender, regal sword imbued with the lovely, green Rathian's might and pride.

weapons.name: F Blango Spear
weapons.description: A spear forged from wood gathered in bitter cold. Its tip alone is chilling.
weapons.description_de: Ein Speer aus Holz, das in bitterer Kälte gesammelt wurde; mit eiskalter Spitze.
weapons.description_fr: Lance faite d'un bois ramassé par un froid de canard. Sa pointe est glaçante.
weapons.description_es: Venablo forjado con madera recogida en zonas muy frías. Su punzada es escalofriante.
weapons.description_it: Asta ricavata dal legname di terre molto fredde. La sua punta mette i brividi.
weapons.description_zh: A spear forged from wood gathered in bitter cold. Its tip alone is chilling.

weapons.name: F Ceanataur Cutter
weapons.description: A sharp weapon whose blade is honed to cut through even the thickest hairballs.
weapons.description_de: Eine echt scharfe Waffe. Die Klinge schneidet selbst durch die dicksten Haarknäule.
weapons.description_fr: Arme dont la lame est assez affûtée pour couper les boules de poils les plus épaisses.
weapons.description_es: Afilada arma cuya hoja está pulida para atravesar hasta las más espesas bolas de pelo.
weapons.description_it: Arma con una lama talmente affilata da poter tagliare qualunque palla di pelo.
weapons.description_zh: A sharp weapon whose blade is honed to cut through even the thickest hairballs.

weapons.name: F Naja Pungi
weapons.description: A weapon that looks like a snake charmer's flute... but doesn't work like one.
weapons.description_de: Die Waffe sieht aus wie eine Schlangenbeschwörer-Flöte, funktioniert aber anders.
weapons.description_fr: Ressemble à une flûte de charmeur de serpents. Mais la comparaison s'arrête là.
weapons.description_es: Arma semejante a la flauta de un encantador de serpientes. Las similitudes terminan ahí.
weapons.description_it: Ricorda un flauto da incantatore di serpenti... ma è privo dei suoi poteri.
weapons.description_zh: A weapon that looks like a snake charmer's flute... but doesn't work like one.

weapons.name: F Narga Shuriken
weapons.description: An old, exotic weapon from the East. The deadly blade becomes shadow when thrown.
weapons.description_de: Alte, exotische Waffe des Ostens. Die Klinge wird beim Werfen zu einem Schatten.
weapons.description_fr: Arme ancienne d'origine orientale. En vol, la lame mortelle devient ombre.
weapons.description_es: Antigua y exótica arma traída de Oriente. Su filo mortal se torna una sombra al atacar.
weapons.description_it: Antica arma orientale. Se lanciata, la sua lama si tramuta in ombra.
weapons.description_zh: An old, exotic weapon from the East. The deadly blade becomes shadow when thrown.

weapons.name: F Kokoto Beer
weapons.description: A weapon devised by a Palico with a love for drinking. Just as good at the table.
weapons.description_de: Ein trinkfreudiger Kamerad entwarf diese Waffe, die einfach jeden umhaut.
weapons.description_fr: Arme conçue par un Palico épris de boisson. S'apprécie surtout à table.
weapons.description_es: Arma ideada por un camarada amante de la bebida. Buena como arma y sabrosa en la mesa.
weapons.description_it: Arma progettata da un compagno con il vizio del bere. È ottima anche a tavola.
weapons.description_zh: A weapon devised by a Palico with a love for drinking. Just as good at the table.

weapons.name: F Pokke Mop
weapons.description: A weapon with plenty of applications at home, too. Superb for dusting.
weapons.description_de: Eine Multifunktionswaffe, auch im eigenen Heim einsetzbar. Tödlich gegen Spinnweben.
weapons.description_fr: Arme qui fait aussi des merveilles dans la maison. Impeccable pour épousseter.
weapons.description_es: Arma que también tiene muchas aplicaciones domésticas. Excelente para quitar el polvo.
weapons.description_it: Arma molto utile anche in casa. È imbattibile per sconfiggere la polvere.
weapons.description_zh: A weapon with plenty of applications at home, too. Superb for dusting.

weapons.name: F Yukumo Fan
weapons.description: A popular Yukumo Hot Springs souvenir. One flap blows away monsters and heat alike.
weapons.description_de: Ein beliebtes Souvenir von den heißen Quellen von Yukumo. Fächelt Hitze und Monster weg.
weapons.description_fr: Souvenir des sources naturelles de Yukumo. Chasse les monstres et dissipe la chaleur.
weapons.description_es: Souvenir popular de Yukumo Hot Springs. Agítalo para librarte de los monstruos y el calor.
weapons.description_it: Un apprezzato souvenir delle terme di Yukumo. Sconfigge mostri e calura al primo colpo.
weapons.description_zh: A popular Yukumo Hot Springs souvenir. One flap blows away monsters and heat alike.

weapons.name: F Shroom Rod
weapons.description: An inventive weapon made of Mushrooms. One wrong move can leave a stunning surprise.
weapons.description_de: Eine aus Pilzen hergestellte innovative Waffe mit teils fantastischen Effekten.
weapons.description_fr: Arme originale faite avec des champignons. Avec une surprise en cas de faux mouvement.
weapons.description_es: Ingeniosa arma hecha de setas. Un movimiento en falso puede causar una increíble sorpresa.
weapons.description_it: Arma ingegnosa ricavata da funghi. Una mossa sbagliata e te ne pentirai amaramente.
weapons.description_zh: An inventive weapon made of Mushrooms. One wrong move can leave a stunning surprise.

weapons.name: F Eldora Paw
weapons.description: An extravagant Catburglar made out of treasures found by the Meownster Hunters.
weapons.description_de: Extravaganter Katzendieb aus Schätzen, die die Miaunster- Jäger gesammelt haben.
weapons.description_fr: Étonnant chat voleur élaboré à partir de trésors découverts par les Chasseurs de miaonstres.
weapons.description_es: Extravagante ladrón gato hecho de tesoros encontrados por los cazamiaunstruos.
weapons.description_it: Opulento svaligiatore forgiato con i tesori rinvenuti dai cacciatori di miaostri.
weapons.description_zh: An extravagant Catburglar made out of treasures found by the Meownster Hunters.

weapons.name: F Garuga Fan
weapons.description: A Yian Garuga feather fan. Its eerie power summons great gales. Or was it tall tales?
weapons.description_de: Fächer aus Yian-Garuga- Federn. Beschwört angeblich Stürme herauf.
weapons.description_fr: Éventail de plumes de Yian Garuga. Capable d'invoquer des tempêtes, paraît-il...
weapons.description_es: Hecho con plumas de Yian Garuga. Dicen que invoca tempestades... ¿Será cierto?
weapons.description_it: Ventaglio di piume di Yian Garuga. Ha il potere di evocare il vento. Che spavento!
weapons.description_zh: A Yian Garuga feather fan. Its eerie power summons great gales. Or was it tall tales?

weapons.name: F Uragaan Iron
weapons.description: A lump of iron reported to be the heaviest Palico weapon. But oh, the power!
weapons.description_de: Dieser Eisenbrocken soll die schwerste Kameraden-Waffe sein. Aber diese Kraft!
weapons.description_fr: La plus lourde des armes de Palico. Mais... quelle puissance !
weapons.description_es: Una mole de hierro casi más pesada que tu mismo camarada, pero... ¡es potentísimo!
weapons.description_it: Blocco di ferro considerato l'arma più pesante dei compagni. E che potenza!
weapons.description_zh: A lump of iron reported to be the heaviest Palico weapon. But oh, the power!

weapons.name: F Rathalos Blade
weapons.description: A Palico great sword that blasts anything it slices with fiery Rathalos breath.
weapons.description_de: Dieses Kameraden-Großschwert trifft alle seine Ziele mit feurigem Rathalos-Atem.
weapons.description_fr: Grande épée de Palico qui pulvérise ce qu'elle fend avec le souffle de Rathalos.
weapons.description_es: Una gran espada de camarada que con cada corte escupe un ardiente aliento de Rathalos.
weapons.description_it: Spadone dei compagni che incenerisce con alito di Rathalos ciò che colpisce.
weapons.description_zh: A Palico great sword that blasts anything it slices with fiery Rathalos breath.

weapons.name: F Lagia Anchor
weapons.description: A piratey item marketed squarely at Felynes who say "meawrrr" instead of "meow."
weapons.description_de: Ein spezielles Piratenobjekt für solche Felyne, die lieber "Miarrr" als "Miau" sagen.
weapons.description_fr: Arme de style pirate pour les Felynes qui préfèrent le rhum au lait.
weapons.description_es: Un objeto piratesco para los Felyne que prefieren el ron marinero a la leche.
weapons.description_it: Oggetto piratesco dedicato ai Felyne che aggiungono un "ahr" a ogni "miao".
weapons.description_zh: A piratey item marketed squarely at Felynes who say "meawrrr" instead of "meow."

weapons.name: F Astalos Spear
weapons.description: A spear with a sharp tip and a shocking poke. One prick spells eternal itches.
weapons.description_de: Ein Speer mit scharfer Spitze und schockendem Stich. Ein Pikser bringt ewiges Jucken.
weapons.description_fr: Lance au bout pointu dont la piqûre démange, démange, et démange encore.
weapons.description_es: Venablo de punta afilada y golpe impactante. Un solo pinchazo provoca un escozor eterno.
weapons.description_it: Trafigge e fulmina con la sua punta aguzza. Un solo affondo condanna a un prurito perenne.
weapons.description_zh: A spear with a sharp tip and a shocking poke. One prick spells eternal itches.

weapons.name: F Enormews Staff
weapons.description: A holy staff thought to let Palicoes control the power of mighty blizzards.
weapons.description_de: Mit diesem sagenhaften Stab sollen Kameraden Schnee- stürme kontrollieren können.
weapons.description_fr: Crosse qui permettrait aux Palicos de maîtriser de puissants blizzards.
weapons.description_es: Bastón sagrado que permite a los camaradas controlar la furia de poderosas ventiscas.
weapons.description_it: Bastone sacro che permette ai compagni di controllare il potere delle tormente.
weapons.description_zh: A holy staff thought to let Palicoes control the power of mighty blizzards.

weapons.name: F Mizutsune Parasol
weapons.description: An umbrella with an alluring Eastern pattern. Famous among Felyne collectors.
weapons.description_de: Ein Schirm mit faszinierendem östlichen Muster. Berühmt unter Felyne-Sammlern.
weapons.description_fr: Parapluie orné d'un superbe motif oriental. Populaire parmi les Palicos collectionneurs.
weapons.description_es: Paraguas con un elegante estampado oriental, codiciado por los coleccionistas Felyne.
weapons.description_it: Ombrellino con accattivanti motivi orientali che lo rendono molto ambito dai compagni.
weapons.description_zh: An umbrella with an alluring Eastern pattern. Famous among Felyne collectors.

weapons.name: F Guild Rapier
weapons.description: A slender sword designed just for the Guild and given to its most fearless.
weapons.description_de: Schlankes Schwert, für die furchtlosesten Mitglieder der Gilde gefertigt.
weapons.description_fr: Épée effilée conçue pour la Guilde et remise à ses combattants les plus braves.
weapons.description_es: Una espada flexible diseñada para el gremio y entregada a los más bravos.
weapons.description_it: Un'agile spada creata per la Gilda e affidata ai suoi membri più temerari.
weapons.description_zh: A slender sword designed just for the Guild and given to its most fearless.

weapons.name: F Moofy Plush
weapons.description: A soft, cuddly stuffed Moofy that's quite popular and makes for a great pillow.
weapons.description_de: Ein weiches, kuschliges, allseits beliebtes Stoff-Muufy, auch toll als Kopfkissen zu verwenden.
weapons.description_fr: Un Moofy tout mignon que tout le monde s'arrache et dont on fait des oreillers.
weapons.description_es: Suave y mimoso Moofy de peluche, que es muy popular y sirve estupendamente de almohada.
weapons.description_it: Un popolare peluche di Moofy morbido e coccoloso che può essere utilizzato come cuscino.
weapons.description_zh: A soft, cuddly stuffed Moofy that's quite popular and makes for a great pillow.

weapons.name: F Scorching Blade
weapons.description: A dual-edged blade made of polished Glavenus Scraps. Cauterizes when it cuts.
weapons.description_de: Eine doppelschneidige Klinge, aus polierten Glavenus-Resten geformt. Brennt Wunden aus.
weapons.description_fr: Lame à double tranchant faite à partir de débris de Glavenus polis. Vertus cautérisantes.
weapons.description_es: Espada de doble filo hecha de restos pulidos de Glavenus. Cauteriza los cortes que provoca.
weapons.description_it: Lama a doppio filo ricavata da scarti di Glavenus. Causa ferite cauterizzanti.
weapons.description_zh: A dual-edged blade made of polished Glavenus Scraps. Cauterizes when it cuts.

weapons.name: F Mewsurper's Peal
weapons.description: A powerful Thunder weapon that sets the skies rumbling and zaps anything it slices.
weapons.description_de: Diese mächtige Donnerwaffe lässt den Himmel grollen und versetzt Zielen Schocks.
weapons.description_fr: Arme de foudre puissante qui fait gronder les cieux et électrocute ses victimes.
weapons.description_es: Un arma de rayo terrible que hace temblar los cielos y electrocuta con cada corte.
weapons.description_it: Potente arma del tuono che fa rombare i cieli e fulmina tutto ciò che attraversa.
weapons.description_zh: A powerful Thunder weapon that sets the skies rumbling and zaps anything it slices.

weapons.name: F Katzenlampe
weapons.description: A cursed Palico weapon made from Gore Magala Scraps. Emits a dark, evil glow.
weapons.description_de: Eine verfluchte Kameraden- waffe, gefertigt aus Gore- Magala-Resten; glüht böse.
weapons.description_fr: Arme maudite de Palico faite avec des débris de Gore Magala. Émet une lueur sombre.
weapons.description_es: Arma para camaradas maldita hecha con restos de Gore Magala. Emite un fulgor oscuro y maligno.
weapons.description_it: Arma per compagni maledetta forgiata con scarti di Gore Magala. Irradia buio, non luce.
weapons.description_zh: A cursed Palico weapon made from Gore Magala Scraps. Emits a dark, evil glow.

weapons.name: F Seregios Edge
weapons.description: A noble warrior's golden axe. A thousand flashes of its blade fell as many monsters.
weapons.description_de: Goldene Axt eines edlen Krie- gers. Tausend Blitze erlegen ebenso viele Monster.
weapons.description_fr: Hache dorée d'un noble héros. L'éclat de sa lame a causé la mort de nombreux monstres.
weapons.description_es: Hacha dorada de un guerrero noble. Cuentan que ha acabado con más de mil monstruos.
weapons.description_it: Ascia di un nobile guerriero. Uccise tanti mostri quanti sono i suoi riflessi dorati.
weapons.description_zh: A noble warrior's golden axe. A thousand flashes of its blade fell as many monsters.

weapons.name: F Tigrex Whammer
weapons.description: A violent mass of Tigrex Scraps that bites into flesh and splinters bone.
weapons.description_de: Ein gnadenloser Haufen aus Tigrex-Teilen, der Fleisch und Knochen zerfetzt.
weapons.description_fr: Condensé de la violence du Tigrex. Déchiquette la chair et broie les os.
weapons.description_es: Una mole hecha de restos de Tigrex que perfora la carne y destroza los huesos.
weapons.description_it: Un poderoso insieme di parti di Tigrex che trapassa le carni e frantuma le ossa.
weapons.description_zh: A violent mass of Tigrex Scraps that bites into flesh and splinters bone.

weapons.name: F Kirin Rumblezap
weapons.description: A Kirin weapon sized down for Palicoes. Thunder can be heard with each thrust.
weapons.description_de: Eine für Kameraden verklei- nerte Kirin-Waffe. Bei jedem Stoß hört man den Donner.
weapons.description_fr: Arme en Kirin de taille adaptée aux Palicos. Fait retentir le tonnerre.
weapons.description_es: Un arma de Kirin reducida, para uso de camaradas. Se escucha un trueno con cada golpe.
weapons.description_it: Arma di Kirin rimpicciolita per compagni. A ogni fendente riecheggia un tuono.
weapons.description_zh: A Kirin weapon sized down for Palicoes. Thunder can be heard with each thrust.

weapons.name: F Brachy Punch
weapons.description: An astonishing blunt weapon with a glove on the end. Digs into targets it hits.
weapons.description_de: Eine erstaunliche Hiebwaffe mit einem Handschuh vorne. Gräbt sich in ihre Ziele.
weapons.description_fr: Arme contondante bizarrement surmontée d'un gant. Fouille les cibles qu'elle touche.
weapons.description_es: Arma contundente de impresión, con un guante en el extremo. Se clava en el objetivo.
weapons.description_it: Grandiosa arma contundente che termina con un guantone. Sfonda ogni bersaglio.
weapons.description_zh: An astonishing blunt weapon with a glove on the end. Digs into targets it hits.

weapons.name: F Le Cœur de Chat
weapons.description: A holy Palico weapon made of Shagaru Magala Scraps with a purifying tip.
weapons.description_de: Eine heilige Kameradenwaffe, gefertigt aus Shagaru-Magala- Resten, mit reinigender Spitze.
weapons.description_fr: Arme de Palico faite de débris de Shagaru Malaga. Sa pointe a des vertus purifiantes.
weapons.description_es: Arma de camaradas sagrada, hecha con restos de Shagaru Magala. Su punta tiene poder purificante.
weapons.description_it: Arma sacra per compagni ricavata da scarti di Shagaru Magala. La punta è purificante.
weapons.description_zh: A holy Palico weapon made of Shagaru Magala Scraps with a purifying tip.

weapons.name: F Kushala Wand
weapons.description: A fan-like weapon containing a Kushala Daora's soul. Its winds banish all rivals.
weapons.description_de: Eine fächerartige Waffe mit einer Kushala-Daora-Seele. Ihr Wind vertreibt Rivalen.
weapons.description_fr: Sorte d'éventail renfermant l'âme d'un Kushala Daora. Fait s'envoler les ennemis.
weapons.description_es: Arma similar a un abanico que contiene el alma de un Kushala Daora. Ataca con viento.
weapons.description_it: Simile a un ventaglio, sferza il nemico con l'anima di un Kushala Daora.
weapons.description_zh: A fan-like weapon containing a Kushala Daora's soul. Its winds banish all rivals.

weapons.name: F Genie Breath
weapons.description: A sword made of Chameleos Scraps. The living mist inside tends to startle Palicoes.
weapons.description_de: Ein Schwert aus Chameleos-Resten. Der lebende Nebel im Inneren erschreckt Kameraden gelegentlich.
weapons.description_fr: Épée faite de débris Chameleos. Renferme une brume vivante qui fait sursauter les Palicos.
weapons.description_es: Espada hecha con restos de Chameleos. La neblina de su interior asusta a los camaradas.
weapons.description_it: Spada ricavata da scarti di Chameleos. Vi alberga una nebbia che spaventa i compagni.
weapons.description_zh: A sword made of Chameleos Scraps. The living mist inside tends to startle Palicoes.

weapons.name: F Kaiser Mace
weapons.description: A superb mace that captures the noble Teostra to a T. All Felynes bow before it.
weapons.description_de: Diese prächtige Keule ver- körpert den edlen Teostra. Die Felyne verehren sie.
weapons.description_fr: Masse somptueuse qui fait honneur au noble Teostra et que tout Felyne vénère.
weapons.description_es: Maza soberbia que refleja la nobleza del Teostra. Los Felyne la adoran.
weapons.description_it: Mazza pregiata che racchiude lo spirito del nobile Teostra. Venerata dai Felyne.
weapons.description_zh: A superb mace that captures the noble Teostra to a T. All Felynes bow before it.

weapons.name: F White Felyne Husk
weapons.description: Free of the curse that once imprisoned it, this husk can bring forth a servant.
weapons.description_de: Von ihrem Fluch befreit, kann diese Hülse nun einen Diener herbeirufen.
weapons.description_fr: Libérée de sa malédiction, cette coque peut faire apparaître un domestique.
weapons.description_es: Libre de la maldición que lo encarcelaba, este bastón puede engendrar a un siervo.
weapons.description_it: Libero dalla maledizione di cui era prigioniero, il guscio può ora invocare un servitore.
weapons.description_zh: Free of the curse that once imprisoned it, this husk can bring forth a servant.

weapons.name: F Bone Wedge S
weapons.description: A traditional cutting weapon favored by Felynes. Sturdy bone is used in the head.
weapons.description_de: Traditionelle, von Felynen bevorzugte Schneidewaffe mit Knochen im Kopfteil.
weapons.description_fr: Arme traditionnelle prisée des Felynes. Extrémité tranchante en os solide.
weapons.description_es: Arma cortante tradicional, preferida por los Felyne. El extremo es muy resistente.
weapons.description_it: Arma da taglio tradizionale dei Felyne, la cui sommità è ricavata da osso robusto.
weapons.description_zh: A traditional cutting weapon favored by Felynes. Sturdy bone is used in the head.

weapons.name: F Bherna Staff S
weapons.description: A Palico weapon with a bell that can control Moofahs. Great for hiking.
weapons.description_de: Eine Kameradenwaffe mit einer Glocke, die Muufahs kontrolliert. Gut im Gebirge.
weapons.description_fr: Arme de Palico munie d'une clochette capable de contrôler les Moofah. Utile en montagne.
weapons.description_es: Arma de camarada con campanilla capaz de controlar Moofah. Genial para ir de excursión.
weapons.description_it: Arma per compagni con una campana che permette di controllare i Moofah. Utile in montagna.
weapons.description_zh: A Palico weapon with a bell that can control Moofahs. Great for hiking.

weapons.name: F Hunting Knife S
weapons.description: Kokoto's iconic weapon, retrofitted for Palico use. A staple hunting item.
weapons.description_de: Kokotos Markenzeichen, für Kameraden nachgerüstet; ein Standardobjekt für die Jagd.
weapons.description_fr: Arme emblématique de Kokoto modernisée pour les Palicos. Tout bon Miaroudeur a le sien.
weapons.description_es: Arma emblemática de Kokoto, modernizada para los camaradas. Todo buen cazador tiene una.
weapons.description_it: L'arma tipica di Kokoto, adattata ai compagni. Ogni buon cacciatore ne possiede uno.
weapons.description_zh: Kokoto's iconic weapon, retrofitted for Palico use. A staple hunting item.

weapons.name: F Yukumo Bonito
weapons.description: A wooden sword carved from strong Yukumo trees. Dishes out some nasty lumps.
weapons.description_de: Ein starkes Schwert aus Yukumo-Holz. Es verursacht schmerzhafte Beulen.
weapons.description_fr: Épée taillée dans le bois dur des arbres de Yukumo. Donne de vilaines bosses.
weapons.description_es: Espada hecha con la madera de robustos árboles de Yukumo. Llena de chichones al rival.
weapons.description_it: Spada di legno ricavata dai fusti dei possenti alberi di Yukumo. Davvero temibile.
weapons.description_zh: A wooden sword carved from strong Yukumo trees. Dishes out some nasty lumps.

weapons.name: F Carbalite Wedge
weapons.description: A traditional Felyne weapon that uses ore for a sharper cutting edge.
weapons.description_de: Traditionelle Felyne-Waffe, die Erz für eine schärfere Schnittkante einsetzt.
weapons.description_fr: Arme Felyne traditionnelle à base de minerai pour un fil plus tranchant.
weapons.description_es: Un arma tradicional Felyne que utiliza el mineral para dar una hoja más afilada.
weapons.description_it: Arma Felyne tradizionale con una lama resa affilata dal minerale usato.
weapons.description_zh: A traditional Felyne weapon that uses ore for a sharper cutting edge.

weapons.name: F Giant Acorn S
weapons.description: A heavy blunt weapon that takes a hollowed-out acorn and packs it with wood.
weapons.description_de: Eine massive, stumpfe Waffe. Besteht aus einer ausgehöhlten Eichel, gefüllt mit Holz.
weapons.description_fr: Arme lourde faite à partir d'une châtaigne évidée puis remplie de bois.
weapons.description_es: Arma contundente sin filo que recoge una bellota hueca y la rellena de madera.
weapons.description_it: Grossa arma contundente ottenuta svuotando una ghianda e riempiendola di legno.
weapons.description_zh: A heavy blunt weapon that takes a hollowed-out acorn and packs it with wood.

weapons.name: F Vprey Wedge S
weapons.description: A traditional Felyne weapon fashioned from the talon of a small, non-native monster.
weapons.description_de: Traditionelle Felyne-Waffe aus der Kralle eines nicht einheimischen Monsters.
weapons.description_fr: Arme Felyne traditionnelle fabriquée avec la serre d'un petit monstre allogène.
weapons.description_es: Un arma tradicional Felyne hecha con la garra de un monstruo no autóctono.
weapons.description_it: Arma tradizionale Felyne ricavata dall'artiglio di un mostro non indigeno.
weapons.description_zh: A traditional Felyne weapon fashioned from the talon of a small, non-native monster.

weapons.name: F Barrel Basher S
weapons.description: A big, heavy barrel turned into a weapon. Requires serious muscle to wield.
weapons.description_de: Eine Waffe aus einem großen, schweren Fass. Der Einsatz erfordert viel Muskelkraft.
weapons.description_fr: Baril lourd et volumineux utilisé comme arme. Réservé aux costauds.
weapons.description_es: Un enorme y pesado barril convertido en arma. Hace falta músculo para usarlo.
weapons.description_it: Arma ricavata da un pesante barile. Solo i più forzuti possono maneggiarla.
weapons.description_zh: A big, heavy barrel turned into a weapon. Requires serious muscle to wield.

weapons.name: F Gourmet Cheese S
weapons.description: An all too appetizing hammer made from fragrant cheese by the Gourmew Chef.
weapons.description_de: Ein appetitlicher Hammer, geformt aus duftendem Käse, hergestellt vom Gourmiau-Koch persönlich.
weapons.description_fr: Marteau très appétissant préparé par le chef Gourmiaou avec du bon fromage.
weapons.description_es: Martillo de lo más apetitoso hecho por el Chef Gourmiau con un queso aromático.
weapons.description_it: Appetitoso martello ottenuto lavorando il formaggio prelibato dello chef Gourmiao.
weapons.description_zh: An all too appetizing hammer made from fragrant cheese by the Gourmew Chef.

weapons.name: F Moofah Cotton S
weapons.description: A weapon made from just enough Moofah cotton to knit a Palico sweater.
weapons.description_de: Eine Waffe aus genau der Menge Muufah-Flausch, die für einen Kameraden-Pullover nötig ist.
weapons.description_fr: Arme faite avec assez de coton de Moofah pour tricoter un pull pour un Palico.
weapons.description_es: Arma hecha con suficiente algodón de Moofah para tejer un jersey de camarada.
weapons.description_it: Arma realizzata con abbastanza cotone di Moofah da cucire un maglione per compagni.
weapons.description_zh: A weapon made from just enough Moofah cotton to knit a Palico sweater.

weapons.name: F Barbecue
weapons.description: A hammer forged from fresh, uncooked meat. Sadly, it's been rendered inedible.
weapons.description_de: Ein Hammer, geschmiedet aus frischem, ungekochtem Fleisch. Leider inzwischen ungenießbar.
weapons.description_fr: Marteau forgé à partir de viande fraîche et crue. Dommage, elle n'est plus comestible.
weapons.description_es: Martillo forjado a partir de carne cruda. Por desgracia, es totalmente incomestible.
weapons.description_it: Martello composto da prelibata carne cruda. Purtroppo, non è più commestibile.
weapons.description_zh: A hammer forged from fresh, uncooked meat. Sadly, it's been rendered inedible.

weapons.name: F Fish Stick S
weapons.description: A primitive-looking Palico weapon made of stone. More useful than it looks.
weapons.description_de: Diese Kameradenwaffe sieht verführerisch aus, aber nimm sie bloß nicht in den Mund!
weapons.description_fr: Arme primitive de Palico faite en pierre. Plus utile qu'elle n'en a l'air.
weapons.description_es: Arma para camaradas hecha de piedra, con aspecto primitivo. Más útil de lo que parece.
weapons.description_it: Arma di pietra per compagni dall'aria primitiva. È più efficace di quanto sembri.
weapons.description_zh: A primitive-looking Palico weapon made of stone. More useful than it looks.

weapons.name: F Fingerlicker
weapons.description: The juiciest part of the bird. Perfect for "drumming up" help from your Palicoes.
weapons.description_de: Das saftigste Vogelstück. Perfekt, um Hilfe von deinen Kameraden herbeizutrommeln.
weapons.description_fr: Le morceau le plus juteux ! Votre Palico rappliquera en vitesse pour vous aider.
weapons.description_es: Hecho con la parte más sabrosa de un ave. Ideal para que tu camarada te eche un muslo.
weapons.description_it: Succosa carne di volatile. Ideale per invocare l'aiuto dei compagni.
weapons.description_zh: The juiciest part of the bird. Perfect for "drumming up" help from your Palicoes.

weapons.name: F Bushwhacker S
weapons.description: A weapon with real punch when it hits. Clearly not made of ordinary wood.
weapons.description_de: Eine Waffe mit ordentlich Rumms, wenn sie trifft. Nicht aus normalem Holz.
weapons.description_fr: Avec une telle force de frappe, cette arme n'est clairement pas faite d'un bois ordinaire.
weapons.description_es: Arma que golpea con gran contundencia. Está claro que no es de madera normal.
weapons.description_it: Arma capace di infliggere colpi terrificanti. Chiaramente non ricavata da legname comune.
weapons.description_zh: A weapon with real punch when it hits. Clearly not made of ordinary wood.

weapons.name: F Paw Punch S
weapons.description: A customary blunt weapon favored by Felynes. Sturdy wood is used in the head.
weapons.description_de: Eine übliche, von Felynen bevorzugte Hiebwaffe. Der Kopf ist aus stabilem Holz.
weapons.description_fr: Arme contondante prisée des Felynes. La patte est composée de bois solide.
weapons.description_es: Arma contundente tradicional preferida por los Felyne. Extremo de madera robusta.
weapons.description_it: Arma speciale dei Felyne, la cui sommità è ricavata da legno robusto.
weapons.description_zh: A customary blunt weapon favored by Felynes. Sturdy wood is used in the head.

weapons.name: F Carbalite Sword
weapons.description: A product of quality ore and three nights of labor. Sharp, or your money back.
weapons.description_de: In drei Arbeitsnächten aus hochwertigem Erz gefertigt. Nicht scharf? Geld zurück!
weapons.description_fr: Fabriquée en trois nuits à base de minerai de qualité. Tranchant garanti.
weapons.description_es: Mineral de calidad y tres noches de trabajo. Afilada, o le devolvemos el dinero.
weapons.description_it: Ricavata da ferro pregiato in tre notti di lavoro. Affilatura garantita.
weapons.description_zh: A product of quality ore and three nights of labor. Sharp, or your money back.

weapons.name: F Bone Hammer S
weapons.description: A light yet durable hammer slapped together from easy- to-find bones.
weapons.description_de: Ein leichter, aber stabiler Hammer; aus jederzeit zu findenden Knochen gefertigt.
weapons.description_fr: Marteau à base d'os communs. À la fois léger et solide.
weapons.description_es: Un martillo ligero a la par que resistente, hecho de huesos comunes.
weapons.description_it: Martello leggero e robusto, realizzato fissando insieme ossa di facile reperibilità.
weapons.description_zh: A light yet durable hammer slapped together from easy- to-find bones.

weapons.name: F Alta Net S
weapons.description: A Bug Net cleverly reworked for offense. Insects fear the sight of it.
weapons.description_de: Ein Käfernetz, für den Angriff umfunktioniert. Insekten erzittern bei seinem Anblick.
weapons.description_fr: Ingénieusement repensé pour l'attaque, ce filet est redouté par les insectes.
weapons.description_es: Mosquitera astutamente alterada para el ataque. Los insectos se asustan con solo mirarla.
weapons.description_it: Un retino ingegnosamente modificato a scopo offensivo. Molto temuto dagli insetti.
weapons.description_zh: A Bug Net cleverly reworked for offense. Insects fear the sight of it.

weapons.name: F Bnaha Dagger S
weapons.description: A thin-bladed, vibrant knife resembling a feather. Sharp enough to cut the wind.
weapons.description_de: Eine Klinge, dünn wie eine Feder, scharf genug, den Wind zu schneiden.
weapons.description_fr: Joli couteau à fine lame ressemblant à une plume. Capable de trancher le vent.
weapons.description_es: Cuchillo radiante de hoja fina similar a una pluma. Tan afilado que podría cortar el viento.
weapons.description_it: Coltello sottile e agile come una piuma. È tanto affilato da tagliare il vento.
weapons.description_zh: A thin-bladed, vibrant knife resembling a feather. Sharp enough to cut the wind.

weapons.name: F Jaggi Knife S
weapons.description: A small blade made of common Great Jaggi Scraps. Weak, but a cinch to use.
weapons.description_de: Kleine Klinge aus einfachen Großjaggi-Teilen. Schwach, aber leicht zu handhaben.
weapons.description_fr: Petite lame fabriquée à base de Grand Jaggi. Faible, mais très facile à manier.
weapons.description_es: Pequeña hoja hecha de restos de Gran Jaggi común. Débil, pero fácil de usar.
weapons.description_it: Spadino ricavato da parti comuni di Gran Jaggi. Poco incisivo, ma maneggevole.
weapons.description_zh: A small blade made of common Great Jaggi Scraps. Weak, but a cinch to use.

weapons.name: F Rheno Hammer S
weapons.description: A hammer crafted by fusing metal to Rhenoplos Scraps. Wieldier than it looks.
weapons.description_de: Ein Hammer aus Metall und Rhenoplos-Teilen. Handlicher als er aussieht.
weapons.description_fr: Fait d'un alliage de métal et de Rhenoplos. Plus facile à manier qu'il n'en a l'air.
weapons.description_es: Martillo hecho con metal y restos de Rhenoplos. No es muy difícil de blandir.
weapons.description_it: Ottenuto fondendo metallo con resti di Rhenoplos. Più agile di quanto appaia.
weapons.description_zh: A hammer crafted by fusing metal to Rhenoplos Scraps. Wieldier than it looks.

weapons.name: F Slagtoth Leaf
weapons.description: The Slagtoth Scraps loaded into this weapon allow it to release small rivers with each blow.
weapons.description_de: Diese Waffe aus reichlich Slagtoth-Teilen erzeugt bei jedem Schlag kleine Flüsse.
weapons.description_fr: Arme composée de grands morceaux de Slagtoth. Libère des ruisseaux à chaque coup.
weapons.description_es: Un arma cargada de restos de Slagtoth, que le permiten liberar pequeños ríos al golpear.
weapons.description_it: Arma composta da numerosi resti di Slagtoth che genera ondate a ogni colpo.
weapons.description_zh: The Slagtoth Scraps loaded into this weapon allow it to release small rivers with each blow.

weapons.name: F Maccao Dagger S
weapons.description: A dagger made from Maccao Scraps. Its pommel feathers are especially eye-catching.
weapons.description_de: Ein Dolch, hergestellt aus Maccao-Resten. Die Federn am Knauf sehen toll aus.
weapons.description_fr: Faite à partir de débris de Maccao. Les plumes de son pommeau interrogent le regard.
weapons.description_es: Daga hecha con restos de Maccao. Su puño de plumas es especialmente llamativo.
weapons.description_it: Pugnale ricavato da scarti di Maccao. Le piume sul manico sono molto vistose.
weapons.description_zh: A dagger made from Maccao Scraps. Its pommel feathers are especially eye-catching.

weapons.name: F Vprey Bayonet S
weapons.description: A gun-shaped bayonet with a cute checkered pattern. Despite its appearance, it can't fire.
weapons.description_de: Gewehrförmiges Bajonett mit süßem Kästchenmuster. Kann aber trotzdem nicht schießen.
weapons.description_fr: Ornée d'un joli motif en damier, cette arme ne tire aucun projectile malgré son apparence.
weapons.description_es: Bayoneta en forma de pistola con bello estampado a cuadros. Pese a su aspecto, no dispara.
weapons.description_it: Baionetta a forma di pistola decorata a scacchi. Nonostante l'aspetto, non può sparare.
weapons.description_zh: A gun-shaped bayonet with a cute checkered pattern. Despite its appearance, it can't fire.

weapons.name: F Bulldrome Tusk S
weapons.description: A hammer that slams into prey as hard as a Bulldrome. Each swing smells beastly.
weapons.description_de: Dieser Hammer rammt Beute so hart wie ein Bulldrome. Sein Schwung riecht bestialisch.
weapons.description_fr: Heurte ses proies avec la force d'un Bulldrome. Dégage une odeur bestiale.
weapons.description_es: Un martillo que embiste a la presa con la fuerza de un Bulldrome. Huele a bestia.
weapons.description_it: Martello che si abbatte sulla preda con la forza e l'olezzo di un Bulldrome.
weapons.description_zh: A hammer that slams into prey as hard as a Bulldrome. Each swing smells beastly.

weapons.name: F Arzuros Mace S
weapons.description: A weapon made by condensing Arzuros shells for rigidity. Hits as hard as a real Arzy.
weapons.description_de: Stabile Waffe aus verdichte- ten Arzuros-Panzern. Schlägt so hart wie das Original.
weapons.description_fr: En carapace compressée pour une rigidité optimale. Cogne aussi fort que le vrai Arzy.
weapons.description_es: Un arma hecha con una amalgama de corazas de Arzuros. Golpea tan fuerte como uno vivo.
weapons.description_it: Arma rinforzata condensando gusci di Arzuros. Colpisce con la potenza di un Arzy.
weapons.description_zh: A weapon made by condensing Arzuros shells for rigidity. Hits as hard as a real Arzy.

weapons.name: F Genprey Bayonet S
weapons.description: A soldier's best close-range friend, now for Palicoes. So what if it can't fire?
weapons.description_de: Der beste Freund des Soldaten, auf kurze Distanz. Jetzt für Kameraden, nur ohne Schießen.
weapons.description_fr: La fidèle arme du soldat, dans sa version pour Palico. Ne tire aucun projectile, et alors ?
weapons.description_es: Arma ideal de corto alcance para soldados y ahora para camaradas. ¿Qué más da que no dispare?
weapons.description_it: Arma da mischia per soldati, ora anche per compagni. E poco importa se non può sparare.
weapons.description_zh: A soldier's best close-range friend, now for Palicoes. So what if it can't fire?

weapons.name: F Lagombi Staff S
weapons.description: A darling but dangerous item that launches a slab of ice with each strike.
weapons.description_de: Hübsch, aber gefährlich: Diese Waffe schleudert mit jedem Schlag eine Eisplatte.
weapons.description_fr: Adorable, mais redoutable. Projette un bloc de glace à chaque attaque.
weapons.description_es: Un objeto encantador, a la par que peligroso, que lanza carámbanos a cada golpe.
weapons.description_it: Arma elegante ma temibile che accompagna ogni fendente con una scarica di ghiaccio.
weapons.description_zh: A darling but dangerous item that launches a slab of ice with each strike.

weapons.name: F Cephalos Brush S
weapons.description: A neat freak's dream weapon. Dusty monster got you down? Break out this brush!
weapons.description_de: Traumwaffe jedes Putzteufels! Rücken dir staubige Monster auf die Pelle? Besen raus!
weapons.description_fr: Arme pour maniaque. Vous avez mordu la poussière ? Cette brosse est pour vous !
weapons.description_es: Cepillo para maniáticos de la limpieza. ¿Que tienes un monstruo sucio? ¡A por él!
weapons.description_it: L'arma preferita dai patiti dell'igiene. Dai una ripulita a quei mostri sporcaccioni!
weapons.description_zh: A neat freak's dream weapon. Dusty monster got you down? Break out this brush!

weapons.name: F Kut-Ku Cutter S
weapons.description: A grand sword made of Yian Kut-Ku Scraps. (No, it's not a fan... Stop asking.)
weapons.description_de: Grandioses Schwert aus Yian- Kut-Ku-Teilen. (Nein, es ist kein Fächer... Basta.)
weapons.description_fr: Grande épée à base de Yian Kut-Ku. Non, non... ce n'est pas un éventail.
weapons.description_es: Una gran espada hecha de restos de Yian Kut-Ku (y no, no es un abanico).
weapons.description_it: Nobile spada forgiata con resti di Yian Kut-Ku (e no, non è un ventaglio).
weapons.description_zh: A grand sword made of Yian Kut-Ku Scraps. (No, it's not a fan... Stop asking.)

weapons.name: F Gypceros Glare S
weapons.description: An ancient weapon governing resurrection. Its mystic power makes fish fresh again.
weapons.description_de: Herrscht über die Wieder- auferstehung. Seine Macht macht Fisch wieder frisch.
weapons.description_fr: Arme ancienne capable de résurrection. Redonne leur fraîcheur aux poissons.
weapons.description_es: Un arma antigua que controla la resurrección. Hace que el pescado siempre esté fresco.
weapons.description_it: Arma antica che governa la resurrezione. Ha il potere di rendere fresco il pesce.
weapons.description_zh: An ancient weapon governing resurrection. Its mystic power makes fish fresh again.

weapons.name: F Cabra Pounder S
weapons.description: A mighty humorous weapon that can get even the saddest kids to burst out laughing.
weapons.description_de: Eine mächtig lustige Waffe, die selbst die traurigsten Kinder zum Lachen bringt.
weapons.description_fr: Arme irrésistiblement drôle capable de faire éclater de rire les enfants les plus tristes.
weapons.description_es: Arma poderosamente cómica capaz de hacer que el niño más triste explote en carcajadas.
weapons.description_it: Arma talmente buffa che strapperebbe un sorriso anche al bambino più imbronciato.
weapons.description_zh: A mighty humorous weapon that can get even the saddest kids to burst out laughing.

weapons.name: F Daimyo Shears S
weapons.description: A briny Daimyo weapon whose sturdy snips cut through even the most stubborn acorn.
weapons.description_de: Salzige Waffe aus Daimyo. Robuste Schneiden zerteilen die härtesten Eicheln.
weapons.description_fr: Arme marine dont les fermes entailles viennent à bout des châtaignes les plus coriaces.
weapons.description_es: Arma de Daimyo cuyos cortes penetran hasta las bellotas más duras.
weapons.description_it: Arma di Daimyo marino dotata di cesoie che possono tagliare anche le ghiande più dure.
weapons.description_zh: A briny Daimyo weapon whose sturdy snips cut through even the most stubborn acorn.

weapons.name: F Ludroth Paw S
weapons.description: Royal Ludroth claws give this weapon a splash of Water-imbued power.
weapons.description_de: Königs-Ludroth-Klauen geben dieser Waffe einen Spritzer wasserdurchtränkter Kraft.
weapons.description_fr: Arme composée de griffes de Ludroth royal lui conférant la puissance de l'eau.
weapons.description_es: Las garras de Ludroth Real confieren al arma un toque de poder acuático.
weapons.description_it: Gli artigli di Ludroth reale infondono all'arma il potere dell'acqua.
weapons.description_zh: Royal Ludroth claws give this weapon a splash of Water-imbued power.

weapons.name: F Kecha Harrow
weapons.description: The business end may look a little silly...but dang, does it work.
weapons.description_de: Das scharfe Ende wirkt vielleicht etwas albern... aber es funktioniert!
weapons.description_fr: Une efficacité redoutable... malgré un style laissant franchement à désirer.
weapons.description_es: Tiene un aspecto no muy amenazador, pero... lo cierto es que es muy efectiva.
weapons.description_it: La parte contundente può sembrare buffa... ma in azione non fa ridere.
weapons.description_zh: The business end may look a little silly...but dang, does it work.

weapons.name: F Bell Rod
weapons.description: A Thunder-imbued weapon with lots of glowing Thunderbugs hiding in its adorable bulb.
weapons.description_de: Von Donner erfüllte Waffe mit vielen Donnerkäfern in ihrem hübschen Kolben.
weapons.description_fr: Arme imprégnée de foudre dont la jolie cloche recèle des tonnes de foudrinsectes.
weapons.description_es: Un arma imbuida de rayo. En ella habita un enjambre de insectos eléctricos.
weapons.description_it: Arma del tuono dotata di una sfera che racchiude numerosi e luminosi insetti-tuono.
weapons.description_zh: A Thunder-imbued weapon with lots of glowing Thunderbugs hiding in its adorable bulb.

weapons.name: F Gargouille Waltz
weapons.description: A precious Felyne relic repurposed for hunting. Your Palico will hate you.
weapons.description_de: Diese Waffe wurde aus einem Felyne-Relikt hergestellt. Dein Kamerad wird dich hassen.
weapons.description_fr: Précieuse relique Felyne recyclée en arme de chasse. Votre Palico va vous détester.
weapons.description_es: Una valiosa reliquia Felyne remodelada para la caza. Tu camarada te odiará si la usas.
weapons.description_it: Una preziosa reliquia Felyne adattata alla caccia. Il tuo compagno ti odierà.
weapons.description_zh: A precious Felyne relic repurposed for hunting. Your Palico will hate you.

weapons.name: F Venombee Bat S
weapons.description: A scary bat where one swing dispenses stingers aplenty. Keep it out of the ball game!
weapons.description_de: Ein schauriger Schläger, der es ordentlich krachen lässt. Nicht für Ballspiele geeignet.
weapons.description_fr: Batte effrayante propageant une multitude de dards à chaque coup. Interdite sur les terrains !
weapons.description_es: Aterrador bate que lanza muchos aguijones con cada golpe. ¡No lo lleves a un partido!
weapons.description_it: Terribile mazza che dispensa dolore al primo fendente. Non usarla sui campi di gioco!
weapons.description_zh: A scary bat where one swing dispenses stingers aplenty. Keep it out of the ball game!

weapons.name: F Mosgharl Broom S
weapons.description: A blunt weapon villagers once used to shoo monsters away. Great for tidying up!
weapons.description_de: Dorfbewohner verjagten mit dieser Hiebwaffe Monster. Toll zum Saubermachen!
weapons.description_fr: Arme jadis utilisée par les villageois pour chasser les monstres... et balayer.
weapons.description_es: Arma contundente que antaño usaban los aldeanos para espantar a los monstruos.
weapons.description_it: Arma contundente usata per scacciare i mostri. Perfetta anche per le pulizie!
weapons.description_zh: A blunt weapon villagers once used to shoo monsters away. Great for tidying up!

weapons.name: F Meowtetsuken
weapons.description: A hit with Palicoes due to the pawprint hilt. Adorable, yet imposing.
weapons.description_de: Beliebt bei Kameraden dank des Schafts mit Tatzen- abdruck. Süß und imposant.
weapons.description_fr: Les Palicos raffolent de sa garde en forme de patte. Adorable et majestueuse.
weapons.description_es: De moda entre los camaradas por la huella en la empuñadura. Impone sin perder el buen gusto.
weapons.description_it: Apprezzata dai compagni per l'impronta della zampa sopra l'elsa. Bella e terribile.
weapons.description_zh: A hit with Palicoes due to the pawprint hilt. Adorable, yet imposing.

weapons.name: F Pounderpurr
weapons.description: A wooden hammer branded with a pawprint. Popular for its cute yet dashing design.
weapons.description_de: Ein Holzhammer mit Tatzen- abdruck. Ein niedliches, aber schneidiges Design.
weapons.description_fr: Marteau en bois marqué d'une empreinte de patte. Mignon et élégant à la fois.
weapons.description_es: Martillo de madera marcado con una huella. Popular por su diseño bonito y elegante.
weapons.description_it: Martello di legno con l'impronta di una zampa. Tenero ed elegante.
weapons.description_zh: A wooden hammer branded with a pawprint. Popular for its cute yet dashing design.

weapons.name: F Ioprey Bayonet S
weapons.description: The center of rumors about the future of Palico combat. Unable to shoot by design.
weapons.description_de: Angeblich der kommende Trend für Kameradenwaffen; nicht zum Schießen geeignet.
weapons.description_fr: Au centre des rumeurs sur le futur des armes pour Palicos. N'est pas conçue pour tirer.
weapons.description_es: Suscita rumores sobre el futuro bélico de los camaradas. No está diseñada para disparar.
weapons.description_it: Al centro del dibattito sul futuro delle armi per compagni. Progettata per non sparare.
weapons.description_zh: The center of rumors about the future of Palico combat. Unable to shoot by design.

weapons.name: F Volvi Lantern S
weapons.description: A weapon capable of giving its target Paralysis thanks to its Volvidon Scraps.
weapons.description_de: Eine Waffe, die dank ihrer Volvidon-Reste den Gegner lähmen kann.
weapons.description_fr: Arme capable de paralyser sa cible car élaborée à partir de débris de Volvidon.
weapons.description_es: Arma capaz de provocar parálisis gracias a sus restos de Volvidon.
weapons.description_it: Arma capace di paralizzare il bersaglio grazie agli scarti di Volvidon da cui è ricavata.
weapons.description_zh: A weapon capable of giving its target Paralysis thanks to its Volvidon Scraps.

weapons.name: F Khezu Whaccine S
