weapons.name: F Guildcalibur X
weapons.description: A slender sword designed just for the Guild and given to its most fearless.
weapons.description_de: Schlankes Schwert, für die furchtlosesten Mitglieder der Gilde gefertigt.
weapons.description_fr: Épée effilée conçue pour la Guilde et remise à ses combattants les plus braves.
weapons.description_es: Una espada flexible diseñada para el gremio y entregada a los más bravos.
weapons.description_it: Un'agile spada creata per la Gilda e affidata ai suoi membri più temerari.
weapons.description_zh: A slender sword designed just for the Guild and given to its most fearless.

weapons.name: F Dragon Forevertones
weapons.description: An instrument whose sounds cannot be heard by most. It sings of eternal life.
weapons.description_de: Instrument, dessen Töne nur Wenige hören können. Es singt vom ewigen Leben.
weapons.description_fr: Instrument inaudible pour la plupart, son chant célèbre la vie éternelle.
weapons.description_es: Instrumento cuyo sonido no es audible para la mayoría. Suya es la canción de la eternidad.
weapons.description_it: Strumento che emette suoni per molti impercettibili. Canta l'eternità della vita.
weapons.description_zh: An instrument whose sounds cannot be heard by most. It sings of eternal life.

weapons.name: F Pro Dirty Blade
weapons.description: A blade the Argosy Captain gives to Dirty Fencing deshi. "Deshi" means pupil!
weapons.description_de: Klinge, die der Argosy-Kapitän dem Schmutziges-Fechten-Deshi gibt. "Deshi" heißt Schüler!
weapons.description_fr: Lame offerte par le capitaine de l'Argosy aux disciples de l'Escrime extrême.
weapons.description_es: El capitán del Argosy la entrega a su deshi de esgrima baja. "Deshi" es "discípulo".
weapons.description_it: Consegnata dal capitano del mercantile al suo deshi. "Deshi" significa allievo!
weapons.description_zh: A blade the Argosy Captain gives to Dirty Fencing deshi. "Deshi" means pupil!

weapons.name: F Meowsketeer Espada
weapons.description: A replica of d'Artanyan's famous sword. Only a skilled paw can master it.
weapons.description_de: Die Replik eines Schwertes von D'Artagnan; nur für talentierte Pfoten!
weapons.description_fr: Réplique de la célèbre épée de d'Artamiaou. Sa maîtrise demande un sacré coup de patte.
weapons.description_es: Réplica del arma de un famoso miausquetero. Solo para las patas más hábiles.
weapons.description_it: Riproduzione di una spada leggendaria cercata da molti miaoschettieri.
weapons.description_zh: A replica of d'Artanyan's famous sword. Only a skilled paw can master it.

weapons.name: F Legend Blade
weapons.description: The storied hunter Sword remade for Palico use, sure to be just as legendary.
weapons.description_de: Sagenumwobenes Jägerschwert, für Kameraden nachgebaut. Sicher bald ebenso legendär.
weapons.description_fr: Version pour Palico de la fameuse épée de chasseur. Une légende en devenir.
weapons.description_es: La espada del célebre cazador, rediseñada para los camaradas, y sin duda igual de legendaria.
weapons.description_it: Riproduzione per compagni della mitica spada da cacciatore, altrettanto leggendaria.
weapons.description_zh: The storied hunter Sword remade for Palico use, sure to be just as legendary.

weapons.name: F Miaownifique
weapons.description: A replica of the Pub Manager's favorite fan. It's a bit...garish?
weapons.description_de: Dem Lieblingsfächer der Tavernen- Managerin nachempfunden. Ein Meisterwerk an Eleganz.
weapons.description_fr: Inspirée de l'éventail préféré de la Taulière, cette arme est des plus efficaces !
weapons.description_es: Réplica del abanico favorito de la dueña de la taberna. Es un pelín recargado.
weapons.description_it: Riproduzione del ventaglio sfoggiato dalla manager della taverna. Un pochino vistoso?
weapons.description_zh: A replica of the Pub Manager's favorite fan. It's a bit...garish?

weapons.name: F Purrlissimo
weapons.description: Made by Felynes who dream of being a Questender. Maybe try studying?
weapons.description_de: Der Questkeeper bestimmte die Form. Zu allererst muss man helfen!
weapons.description_fr: Fabriqué par un Felyne qui adorait le Brasseur de quêtes. Peut toujours servir.
weapons.description_es: Elaborado por un Felyne que quiere trabajar de mesionero. ¡Ya puede dar el callo!
weapons.description_it: Arma realizzata da Felyne che sognano di diventare missionatori della taverna.
weapons.description_zh: Made by Felynes who dream of being a Questender. Maybe try studying?

weapons.name: F Agnaktor Lance X
weapons.description: A weapon whose maw finds chinks in armor and fills them with scalding fire.
weapons.description_de: Der Schlund dieser Waffe füllt Schwachstellen einer Rüstung mit loderndem Feuer.
weapons.description_fr: Sa mâchoire décèle les failles d'une armure pour y souffler un brasier ardent.
weapons.description_es: Un arma cuyas fauces buscan huecos en la armadura. Expulsa fuego abrasador.
weapons.description_it: Le sue fauci aggrediscono i punti deboli delle corazze e vi instillano il fuoco.
weapons.description_zh: A weapon whose maw finds chinks in armor and fills them with scalding fire.

weapons.name: F Duram Axe X
weapons.description: A weapon weighted with a heavy tailbone to maximize the cutting force of blows.
weapons.description_de: Das Schweifknochen-Gewicht maximiert die Schneidkraft der Hiebe mit dieser Waffe.
weapons.description_fr: Arme lestée d'une lourde queue pour maximiser la force tranchante des coups.
weapons.description_es: Un arma con un pesado coxis a modo de contrapeso para maximizar los golpes.
weapons.description_it: Arma zavorrata con un osso caudale che ne amplifica la potenza dei colpi.
weapons.description_zh: A weapon weighted with a heavy tailbone to maximize the cutting force of blows.

weapons.name: F Seregios Edge X
weapons.description: A noble warrior's golden axe. A thousand flashes of its blade fell as many monsters.
weapons.description_de: Goldene Axt eines edlen Krie- gers. Tausend Blitze erlegen ebenso viele Monster.
weapons.description_fr: Hache dorée d'un noble héros. L'éclat de sa lame a causé la mort de nombreux monstres.
weapons.description_es: Hacha dorada de un guerrero noble. Cuentan que ha acabado con más de mil monstruos.
weapons.description_it: Ascia di un nobile guerriero. Uccise tanti mostri quanti sono i suoi riflessi dorati.
weapons.description_zh: A noble warrior's golden axe. A thousand flashes of its blade fell as many monsters.

weapons.name: F Diablos Hammer X
weapons.description: Hits like a raging Diablos, and drives enemies crazy with covetous desire.
weapons.description_de: Diese kampflustige Axt schlägt mit der ganzen Wildheit des Diablos zu.
weapons.description_fr: Arme assoiffée de bataille qui déverse la férocité du Diablos sur ses proies.
weapons.description_es: Fuerte como un Diablos salvaje, hace que los enemigos se alejen.
weapons.description_it: Colpisce come un Diablos furente e riempie il cuore dei nemici di avida bramosia.
weapons.description_zh: Hits like a raging Diablos, and drives enemies crazy with covetous desire.

weapons.name: F Brachydios Smash
weapons.description: An astonishing blunt weapon with a glove on the end. Digs into targets it hits.
weapons.description_de: Eine erstaunliche Hiebwaffe mit einem Handschuh vorne. Gräbt sich in ihre Ziele.
weapons.description_fr: Arme contondante bizarrement surmontée d'un gant. Fouille les cibles qu'elle touche.
weapons.description_es: Arma contundente de impresión, con un guante en el extremo. Se clava en el objetivo.
weapons.description_it: Grandiosa arma contundente che termina con un guantone. Sfonda ogni bersaglio.
weapons.description_zh: An astonishing blunt weapon with a glove on the end. Digs into targets it hits.

weapons.name: F La Venyasss
weapons.description: A holy Palico weapon made of Shagaru Magala Scraps with a purifying tip.
weapons.description_de: Eine heilige Kameradenwaffe, gefertigt aus Shagaru-Magala- Resten, mit reinigender Spitze.
weapons.description_fr: Arme de Palico faite de débris de Shagaru Malaga. Sa pointe a des vertus purifiantes.
weapons.description_es: Arma de camaradas sagrada, hecha con restos de Shagaru Magala. Su punta tiene poder purificante.
weapons.description_it: Arma sacra per compagni ricavata da scarti di Shagaru Magala. La punta è purificante.
weapons.description_zh: A holy Palico weapon made of Shagaru Magala Scraps with a purifying tip.

weapons.name: F Dragon Comet
weapons.description: Falls like a silvery meteor to lightly sever life from flesh.
weapons.description_de: Fällt wie ein silbriger Meteor und trennt mühelos den Körper von der Seele.
weapons.description_fr: Fond sur l'ennemi tel un météore, laissant derrière elle une traînée argentée.
weapons.description_es: De gran belleza y brillante como una estrella, cercena la vida de sus rivales.
weapons.description_it: Ricade come una meteora argentata per togliere la vita con grazia.
weapons.description_zh: Falls like a silvery meteor to lightly sever life from flesh.

weapons.name: F Golden Gadget X
weapons.description: A Rajang talisman. (Polite hunters pretend they can't see the Palico using it.)
weapons.description_de: Ein Rajang-Talisman. (Höfli- che Jäger tun so, als ob sie den Kameraden nicht sehen.)
weapons.description_fr: Talisman à base de Rajang. Feignez de ne pas voir votre Palico l'utiliser.
weapons.description_es: Un talismán hecho de Rajang. Un cazador educado fingirá no ver al camarada que lo usa.
weapons.description_it: Talismano Rajang (usandolo, i cacciatori educati fingono di non vedere i compagni).
weapons.description_zh: A Rajang talisman. (Polite hunters pretend they can't see the Palico using it.)

weapons.name: F Vangis Mace X
weapons.description: A blunt weapon as hungry as the Deviljho. Its blows are utterly devoid of mercy.
weapons.description_de: Eine Hiebwaffe, so hungrig wie der Dämonjho. Ihre Treffer kennen keine Gnade.
weapons.description_fr: Arme contondante aussi vorace que le Deviljho. Tout simplement impitoyable.
weapons.description_es: Arma contundente tan voraz como el Deviljho. Sus ataques son despiadados.
weapons.description_it: Arma contundente famelica come il Deviljho. Colpisce senza alcuna pietà.
weapons.description_zh: A blunt weapon as hungry as the Deviljho. Its blows are utterly devoid of mercy.

weapons.name: F Fischfleisch
weapons.description: Settle an argument: Does this resemble a tuna or a chicken? What do you think?
weapons.description_de: Eins gibt es noch zu klären: Erinnert diese Waffe an einen Thunfisch oder an ein Huhn?
weapons.description_fr: Selon l'éclairage, sa forme évoquerait tantôt un thon, tantôt un poulet.
weapons.description_es: ¿Esto se parece a un atún o a un pollo? Tú decides, porque no está muy claro.
weapons.description_it: La domanda sorge spontanea: assomiglia a un tonno o a un pollo? Tu che ne pensi?
weapons.description_zh: Settle an argument: Does this resemble a tuna or a chicken? What do you think?

weapons.name: F Kushala Wand X
weapons.description: A fan-like weapon containing a Kushala Daora's soul. Its winds banish all rivals.
weapons.description_de: Eine fächerartige Waffe mit einer Kushala-Daora-Seele. Ihr Wind vertreibt Rivalen.
weapons.description_fr: Sorte d'éventail renfermant l'âme d'un Kushala Daora. Fait s'envoler les ennemis.
weapons.description_es: Arma similar a un abanico que contiene el alma de un Kushala Daora. Ataca con viento.
weapons.description_it: Simile a un ventaglio, sferza il nemico con l'anima di un Kushala Daora.
weapons.description_zh: A fan-like weapon containing a Kushala Daora's soul. Its winds banish all rivals.

weapons.name: F Genie Breath X
weapons.description: A sword made of Chameleos Scraps. The living mist inside tends to startle Palicoes.
weapons.description_de: Ein Schwert aus Chameleos-Resten. Der lebende Nebel im Inneren erschreckt Kameraden gelegentlich.
weapons.description_fr: Épée faite de débris Chameleos. Renferme une brume vivante qui fait sursauter les Palicos.
weapons.description_es: Espada hecha con restos de Chameleos. La neblina de su interior asusta a los camaradas.
weapons.description_it: Spada ricavata da scarti di Chameleos. Vi alberga una nebbia che spaventa i compagni.
weapons.description_zh: A sword made of Chameleos Scraps. The living mist inside tends to startle Palicoes.

weapons.name: F Kaiser Mace X
weapons.description: A superb mace that captures the noble Teostra to a T. All Felynes bow before it.
weapons.description_de: Diese prächtige Keule ver- körpert den edlen Teostra. Die Felyne verehren sie.
weapons.description_fr: Masse somptueuse qui fait honneur au noble Teostra et que tout Felyne vénère.
weapons.description_es: Maza soberbia que refleja la nobleza del Teostra. Los Felyne la adoran.
weapons.description_it: Mazza pregiata che racchiude lo spirito del nobile Teostra. Venerata dai Felyne.
weapons.description_zh: A superb mace that captures the noble Teostra to a T. All Felynes bow before it.

weapons.name: F White Felyne Scepter
weapons.description: Free of the curse that once imprisoned it, this husk can bring forth a servant.
weapons.description_de: Von ihrem Fluch befreit, kann diese Hülse nun einen Diener herbeirufen.
weapons.description_fr: Libérée de sa malédiction, cette coque peut faire apparaître un domestique.
weapons.description_es: Libre de la maldición que lo encarcelaba, este bastón puede engendrar a un siervo.
weapons.description_it: Libero dalla maledizione di cui era prigioniero, il guscio può ora invocare un servitore.
weapons.description_zh: Free of the curse that once imprisoned it, this husk can bring forth a servant.

weapons.name: F Polaris Clawsword
weapons.description: A powerful mystical sword that can make the wielder Master of Hairballs.
weapons.description_de: Ein mächtiges, mystisches Schwert, der Träger wird zum Herrscher über alle Haarbälle.
weapons.description_fr: Puissante épée mystique dont le porteur devient Maître des boules de poils.
weapons.description_es: Poderosa espada mística capaz de convertir a quien la empuña en Señor de las Bolas de pelo.
weapons.description_it: Potente spada mistica che rende chiunque la brandisca un maestro delle palle di pelo.
weapons.description_zh: A powerful mystical sword that can make the wielder Master of Hairballs.

weapons.name: F Engraved Staff
weapons.description: Presented to a king about to make the final journey. The bell makes a haunting sound.
weapons.description_de: Einem König vor seiner letzten Reise dargeboten. Der Klang der Glocken sucht die Seele heim.
weapons.description_fr: Offerte à un roi à l'occasion de son dernier voyage. La clochette produit un son obsédant.
weapons.description_es: Se lo regalaron a un rey a punto de emprender su último viaje.
weapons.description_it: Dono di benvenuto per un re che sano e salvo fa ritorno dal mondo dei morti.
weapons.description_zh: Presented to a king about to make the final journey. The bell makes a haunting sound.

weapons.name: F Garuga Fan XR
weapons.description: A weapon made from Hyper Yian Garuga Scraps bearing great power and abilities.
weapons.description_de: Eine Waffe von unglaublicher Macht, gefertigt aus Ferus- Yian-Garuga-Resten.
weapons.description_fr: Forgé avec des hyper débris de Yian Garuga dotant l'arme de nouvelles propriétés.

weapons.description_it: Arma forgiata con scarti iper di Yian Garuga che dona forza e abilità eccezionali.

weapons.description_fr: Arme emblématique de Kokoto modernisée pour les Palicos. Tout bon Miaroudeur a le sien.
weapons.description_es: Arma emblemática de Kokoto, modernizada para los camaradas. Todo buen cazador tiene una.

weapons.description_zh: Kokoto's iconic weapon, retrofitted for Palico use. A staple hunting item.

weapons.name: F True Yukumo Bokken
weapons.description: A wooden sword carved from strong Yukumo trees. Dishes out some nasty lumps.
weapons.description_de: Ein starkes Schwert aus Yukumo-Holz. Es verursacht schmerzhafte Beulen.
weapons.description_fr: Épée taillée dans le bois dur des arbres de Yukumo. Donne de vilaines bosses.
weapons.description_es: Espada hecha con la madera de robustos árboles de Yukumo. Llena de chichones al rival.
weapons.description_it: Spada di legno ricavata dai fusti dei possenti alberi di Yukumo. Davvero temibile.
weapons.description_zh: A wooden sword carved from strong Yukumo trees. Dishes out some nasty lumps.

weapons.name: F Pokke Mop X
weapons.description: A weapon with plenty of applications at home, too. Superb for dusting.
weapons.description_de: Eine Multifunktionswaffe, auch im eigenen Heim einsetzbar. Tödlich gegen Spinnweben.
weapons.description_fr: Arme qui fait aussi des merveilles dans la maison. Impeccable pour épousseter.
weapons.description_es: Arma que también tiene muchas aplicaciones domésticas. Excelente para quitar el polvo.
weapons.description_it: Arma molto utile anche in casa. È imbattibile per sconfiggere la polvere.
weapons.description_zh: A weapon with plenty of applications at home, too. Superb for dusting.

weapons.name: F Edel Rod X
weapons.description: A weapon made of highland flowers. Its cuteness belies its offensive capabilities.
weapons.description_de: Hergestellt aus Blumen, die nur im Hochgebirge wachsen. Ebenso hübsch wie tödlich.
weapons.description_fr: Arme faite avec des fleurs des hautes terres. Cache bien ses capacités offensives.
weapons.description_es: Arma hecha con flores de las tierras altas, de aspecto tierno pero poderosa en el ataque.
weapons.description_it: Arma ricavata dai fiori degli altopiani. L'aspetto grazioso ne maschera l'efficacia.
weapons.description_zh: A weapon made of highland flowers. Its cuteness belies its offensive capabilities.

weapons.name: F Akantor Sword X
weapons.description: A legendary great sword that explodes with lava and the power of the black god.
weapons.description_de: Dieses legendäre Großschwert steckt voller Lava und der Macht des schwarzen Gottes.
weapons.description_fr: Grande épée qui déchaîne la force du dieu noir dans une explosion de lave.
weapons.description_es: Gran espada legendaria que explota con lava y el poder del dios oscuro.
weapons.description_it: Spadone leggendario che ribolle di lava e del potere del dio dell'oscurità.
weapons.description_zh: A legendary great sword that explodes with lava and the power of the black god.

weapons.name: F Ukanlos Shovel X
weapons.description: A weapon empowered by a god from beyond the icy limits, whose ire brings avalanches.
weapons.description_de: Besitzt die Kraft des Gottes hinter den Eisgrenzen. Sein Zorn löst Lawinen aus.
weapons.description_fr: Renferme la puissance d'un dieu de glace dont la colère provoque des avalanches.
weapons.description_es: Arma fortalecida por un dios más allá de la frontera helada. Su ira provoca avalanchas.
weapons.description_it: Arma che genera slavine liberando l'ira di un dio dei ghiacci remoti.
weapons.description_zh: A weapon empowered by a god from beyond the icy limits, whose ire brings avalanches.

weapons.name: F Celestial Squall
weapons.description: A rare blade given to the sky-god's chosen. It can sunder the earth itself.
weapons.description_de: Eine seltene Klinge für die Erwählten des Himmelsgottes. Kann die Erde spalten.
weapons.description_fr: Lame rare remise à l'élu du dieu du ciel. Capable de fendre la Terre.
weapons.description_es: Una rara espada entregada a los elegidos del dios cielo. Puede desgarrar la tierra.
weapons.description_it: Spada rara assegnata al prescelto del dio del cielo. Può fendere la terra.
weapons.description_zh: A rare blade given to the sky-god's chosen. It can sunder the earth itself.

weapons.name: F Escador Scythe X
weapons.description: A worn scythe the Knight of Alatrea wielded against the gods. Apocalyptic power.
weapons.description_de: Der Ritter von Alatrea schwang sie gegen die Göt- ter. Apokalyptische Macht.
weapons.description_fr: Arme apocalyptique que le Chevalier d'Alatréa brandit contre les dieux.
weapons.description_es: La guadaña que el caballero de Alatrea blandió contra los dioses. Apocalíptica.
weapons.description_it: Falce usata dal Cavaliere di Alatrea contro gli dei. Ha la forza dell'apocalisse.
weapons.description_zh: A worn scythe the Knight of Alatrea wielded against the gods. Apocalyptic power.

weapons.name: F Fatalis Eye
weapons.description: This sword tells of an ancient legend, one that strikes fear into all listeners.
weapons.description_de: Eine alte Legende vom heldenhaften Kampf gegen das Böse. Dies ist die Waffe, von der die Legende erzählt.
weapons.description_fr: Épée liée à une ancienne légende perdue qui remplirait d'effroi le cœur le plus solide.
weapons.description_es: Una antigua leyenda cuenta que esta espada infunde el terror a los enemigos.
weapons.description_it: Quest'arma è la spada di Fatalis narrata in antiche leggende.
weapons.description_zh: This sword tells of an ancient legend, one that strikes fear into all listeners.

weapons.name: F Havoc Eye
weapons.description: A double-edged sword. Bestows great power, but its eye will consume any unworthy bearer.
weapons.description_de: Verleiht übermächtige Kraft, doch ihr Auge verschlingt, wer nicht würdig ist, diese Waffe zu führen.
weapons.description_fr: Confère une grande puissance, mais son œil dévore son porteur s'il ne s'en montre pas digne.
weapons.description_es: Espada de doble filo que concede un gran poder a quien la blande.
weapons.description_it: Spada che dona la forza di combattere le minacce, ma pare sia maledetta.
weapons.description_zh: A double-edged sword. Bestows great power, but its eye will consume any unworthy bearer.

weapons.name: F Fatalis Rod
weapons.description: The crimson eye of this pure white rod will guide the bearer towards redemption.
weapons.description_de: So weiß, dass es blendet. Ihre rote Pupille erkennt Wünsche und weist dem Träger den Weg in die Zukunft.
weapons.description_fr: Sa blancheur est aveuglante. L'œil rouge lit les pensées du porteur et lui montre le chemin.
weapons.description_es: El ojo escarlata que adorna el bastón guía al portador hacia la redención.
weapons.description_it: Un'arma abbagliante, candida come la neve. Dona speranza nel futuro.
weapons.description_zh: The crimson eye of this pure white rod will guide the bearer towards redemption.

weapons.name: F Cutie Moon Rod
weapons.description: In the name of the moon, use the power in this rod to send monsters to sleep!
weapons.description_de: Dieses Zepter schickt Monster im Namen des Mondes in den Tiefschlaf!
weapons.description_fr: Par le pouvoir de la lune, plongez vos ennemis dans un profond sommeil !
weapons.description_es: Cetro sagrado que acumula energía y luego la libera para dormir monstruos.
weapons.description_it: Usa il potere di questo scettro per punire i mostri in nome della luna!
weapons.description_zh: In the name of the moon, use the power in this rod to send monsters to sleep!

weapons.name: F Tsumugari
weapons.description: A glaive with the power to vanquish the evil Orochi... Or, at least, a replica of it.
weapons.description_de: Eine Glefe mit der Macht, den bösen Orochi zu bezwingen. Oder zumindest dessen Replikat...
weapons.description_fr: Glaive qui a le pouvoir de terrasser Orochi. C'est une réplique, boule de poils !
weapons.description_es: Espada con el poder de derrotar al malvado Orochi... o, al menos, una réplica de ella.
weapons.description_it: Arma che possiede il potere di sconfiggere il malefico Orochi... Replica in edizione limitata.
weapons.description_zh: A glaive with the power to vanquish the evil Orochi... Or, at least, a replica of it.

weapons.name: F Arthur's Lance
weapons.description: A brilliant silver lance, so pointy it makes you want to throw it. But please, don't.
weapons.description_de: Eine hervorragende silberne Lanze mit so edler Spitze, dass man sie werfen möchte. Lass es!
weapons.description_fr: Lance d'argent brillante. Très pointue. À lancer absolument ! Hum.
weapons.description_es: Una lanza de plata brillante, tan afilada que te hace querer lanzarla. Pero... no lo hagas.
weapons.description_it: Una brillante lancia d'argento, così appuntita da far venir voglia di... lanciarla. Evita però!

weapons.description: Point at your foe and shout this famous line, otherwise you're doing it wrong.
weapons.description_de: Zeige beherzt auf den Feind und rufe dieses Wort mit voller Inbrunst!
weapons.description_fr: Lorsque vous frappez un monstre avec, criez à gorge déployée : "Objection !"
weapons.description_es: No te olvides de gritar bien alto "¡Protesto!" cuando caces monstruos.
weapons.description_it: Punta il dito e pronuncia con decisione la fatidica parola!

weapons.name: F Spirits Pickaxe
weapons.description: You may think this is just a normal stick with a bone axe, but you'd be WRONG.
weapons.description_de: Wer glaubt, dass das einfach nur ein Stock mit einer Axt dran ist, hat sich geschnitten!
weapons.description_fr: Ressemble à un maillet en os F, mais présente de subtiles différences.
weapons.description_es: Parece una simple Cuña de hueso F, pero si te fijas bien, ¡es muy diferente!
weapons.description_it: A prima vista sembra un bastone con un'ascia d'osso. Niente di più sbagliato!
weapons.description_zh: You may think this is just a normal stick with a bone axe, but you'd be WRONG.

weapons.name: F Korok Branch
weapons.description: A branch carried by a Korok forest spirit. Could be used as a weapon, hypothetically.
weapons.description_de: Von Krog-Waldgeistern getragener Zweig. Könnte sogar als Waffe eingesetzt werden.
weapons.description_fr: Les Korogus l'utilisent pour faire pousser des arbres. Elle peut servir d'arme.
weapons.description_es: Como las que plantan los Kolog por ahí. También sirve para atacar.
weapons.description_it: Ramo di un Korogu, uno spirito della foresta. Può fungere anche da arma.
weapons.description_zh: A branch carried by a Korok forest spirit. Could be used as a weapon, hypothetically.

armor.name: F Acorn Helm
armor.description: Entry-level Felyne Palico head armor. The look that defined a generation!
armor.description_de: Felyne-Kameraden-Kopfschutz für Einsteiger. Der Look einer ganzen Generation!
armor.description_fr: Coiffe Felyne basique pour Palico. Le style de toute une génération !
armor.description_es: Armadura de cabeza básica de los camaradas Felyne. ¡Típica de toda una generación!
armor.description_it: Elmo di base per compagni Felyne. Il suo stile ha fatto epoca!
armor.description_zh: Entry-level Felyne Palico head armor. The look that defined a generation!

armor.name: F Bherna Hood
armor.description: A hat that snugly swaddles the head in protective fabrics. Great for highland work.
armor.description_de: Ein Hut, dessen Stoff den Kopf schützend umhüllt. Ideal für Hochland-Arbeit.
armor.description_fr: Chapeau couvrant la tête de tissus protecteurs. Idéal pour les missions en montagne.
armor.description_es: Un gorro que envuelve la cabeza en tejido protector. Ideal para zonas montañosas.
armor.description_it: Pratico copricapo avvolgente in tessuto protettivo. Ideale per le attività montane.
armor.description_zh: A hat that snugly swaddles the head in protective fabrics. Great for highland work.

armor.name: F Alloy Helm
armor.description: A product of quality ore and three nights of labor. Guaranteed head protection.
armor.description_de: Gefertigt aus Edelerz in drei arbeitsreichen Nächten. Kopfschutz garantiert.
armor.description_fr: Casque en alliage de qualité, qui a nécessité trois nuits de dur labeur et protège bien la tête.
armor.description_es: Un producto de metal de calidad y tres días de trabajo. Su cabeza, a salvo.
armor.description_it: Forgiato con metalli di qualità in tre notti di lavoro. Assicura protezione alla testa.
armor.description_zh: A product of quality ore and three nights of labor. Guaranteed head protection.

armor.name: F Bone Helm
armor.description: Head armor made out of a monster skull. Awakens a Palico's wild side.
armor.description_de: Kopfschutz aus einem Monsterschädel. Weckt die Wildheit in jedem Kameraden.
armor.description_fr: Fabriqué à partir d'un crâne de monstre. Révèle le côté sauvage d'un Palico.
armor.description_es: Armadura de cabeza hecha con el cráneo de un monstruo. Para el camarada más salvaje.
armor.description_it: Elmo ricavato da un teschio di mostro. Risveglia il lato selvaggio dei compagni.
armor.description_zh: Head armor made out of a monster skull. Awakens a Palico's wild side.

armor.name: F Jaggi Helm
armor.description: Popular head armor made from supple Great Jaggi hide. Affords reliable protection.
armor.description_de: Beliebter Kopfschutz aus weicher Großjaggi-Haut. Bietet zuverlässigen Schutz.
armor.description_fr: Casque populaire à base de cuir souple de Grand Jaggi. Protège efficacement.
armor.description_es: Armadura de cabeza popular hecha de piel de Gran Jaggi. Protección fiable.
armor.description_it: Elmo ricavato dalla pelle elastica del Gran Jaggi. Protezione a basso costo.
armor.description_zh: Popular head armor made from supple Great Jaggi hide. Affords reliable protection.

armor.name: F Hunting Helm
armor.description: Kokoto's iconic headgear, retrofitted for Palico use. Conveys an old-school vibe.
armor.description_de: Kokotos Kult-Kopfbedeckung, umgerüstet für Kameraden. Da kommt Nostalgie auf.
armor.description_fr: Célèbre couvre-chef de Kokoto, adapté à vos Palicos. Il fait très "vieille école".
armor.description_es: Icónico casco de Kokoto, ajustado para camaradas. Tiene un aire muy clásico.
armor.description_it: Copricapo tipico di Kokoto, adattato ai compagni. Per chi ama lo stile classico.
armor.description_zh: Kokoto's iconic headgear, retrofitted for Palico use. Conveys an old-school vibe.

armor.name: F Mafumofu Hood
armor.description: Specially made head armor from snowy Pokke Village. Felynes love its warm, fluffy feel.
armor.description_de: Spezial-Kopfschutz aus dem verschneiten Dorf Pokke. Die Felynen lieben seine Wärme.
armor.description_fr: Confectionné dans le village Pokke. Chaud et moelleux, les Felynes en raffolent.
armor.description_es: Armadura de cabeza típica de Pokke. A los Felyne les encanta el calorcito que da.
armor.description_it: Elmo speciale del nevoso villaggio di Pokke. I Felyne ne adorano la morbidezza.
armor.description_zh: Specially made head armor from snowy Pokke Village. Felynes love its warm, fluffy feel.

armor.name: F Yukumo Kasa
armor.description: Head armor fashioned from Yukumo wood and bark. Don't leave home without it!
armor.description_de: Kopfschutz aus Yukumo-Holz und -Rinde. Niemals ohne aus dem Haus gehen!
armor.description_fr: À base de bois et d'écorce de Yukumo. Ne partez pas chasser sans lui !
armor.description_es: Armadura de cabeza hecha con madera y corteza de Yukumo. ¡No salgas de casa sin ella!
armor.description_it: Copricapo ricavato da legno e corteccia di Yukumo. Non uscire mai senza!
armor.description_zh: Head armor fashioned from Yukumo wood and bark. Don't leave home without it!

armor.name: F Alta Hat
armor.description: There isn't a better friend in the fight against bright sunlight than this hat!
armor.description_de: Es gibt keinen besseren Schutz vor der gleißenden Sonne als diesen Hut!
armor.description_fr: Chapeau sans pareil pour résister aux assauts impitoyables de l'astre solaire !
armor.description_es: ¡No hay mejor amigo contra los rayos del sol que este sombrero!
armor.description_it: Questo cappello è l'alleato ideale per difendersi dai raggi del sole!
armor.description_zh: There isn't a better friend in the fight against bright sunlight than this hat!

armor.name: F Rheno Helm
armor.description: High-tech head armor that fuses metal to Rhenoplos shell. Note the cute face.
armor.description_de: Aufwändiger Kopfschutz, der Metall an Rhenoplos-Panzer schmiedet. Überaus niedlich.
armor.description_fr: Casque high-tech en métal et carapace de Rhenoplos. N'est-il pas adorable ?
armor.description_es: Casco de alta tecnología que combina metal y corazas de Rhenoplos. Y es adorable.
armor.description_it: Sofisticato elmo di gusci di Rhenoplos e metallo. Dona un'aria simpatica.
armor.description_zh: High-tech head armor that fuses metal to Rhenoplos shell. Note the cute face.

armor.name: F Bnaha Cap
armor.description: Sunglasses that alleviate the sun's rays AND Dragon and Thunder attacks.
armor.description_de: Eine Sonnenbrille, die neben Sonnenstrahlen auch Drachen- und Donnerangriffe abschwächt.
armor.description_fr: Lunettes protégeant du soleil ET des attaques Dragon et Foudre.
armor.description_es: Gafas de sol que protegen de los rayos del sol y de ataques draco y rayo.
armor.description_it: Occhiali che proteggono dai raggi solari e dagli attacchi drago e tuono.
armor.description_zh: Sunglasses that alleviate the sun's rays AND Dragon and Thunder attacks.

armor.name: F Maccao Helm
armor.description: A stylish feathered helm that takes proper fashion sense to wear well.
armor.description_de: Ein eleganter Helm mit Federn, den nur echte Mode- liebhaber zu tragen wissen.
armor.description_fr: Heaume à plumes élégant, accessoire indispensable des inconditionnels de la mode.
armor.description_es: Elegante sombrero emplumado; solo para quien sepa llevarlo con gracia.
armor.description_it: Elegante elmo piumato che richiede un degno portamento per essere indossato con stile.
armor.description_zh: A stylish feathered helm that takes proper fashion sense to wear well.

armor.name: F Velociprey Helm
armor.description: A hat that folds up nice and cleanly. Tailor-made for the best fit.
armor.description_de: Ein perfekt zusammenfaltbarer Hut. Maßgeschneidert für einen optimalen Sitz.
armor.description_fr: Heaume qui se plie facilement, fait sur mesure pour un confort optimal.
armor.description_es: Sombrero fácil de doblar. Hecho a medida para que quede perfecto.
armor.description_it: Cappello dalle linee semplici. Confezionato su misura per garantire la massima comodità.
armor.description_zh: A hat that folds up nice and cleanly. Tailor-made for the best fit.

armor.name: F Bulldrome Mask
armor.description: Head armor that looks ready to charge off one's head. Creates a small stink radius.
armor.description_de: Ein Kopfschutz, der aussieht, als wäre er angriffsbereit. Erzeugt kleinen Stinkradius.
armor.description_fr: Semble prêt à charger sa proie. Entoure son porteur d'un halo nauséabond.
armor.description_es: Armadura de cabeza que parece lista para embestir. Apesta un poco.
armor.description_it: Elmo che sembra pronto a lanciarsi all'attacco. Ti circonda di olezzo.
armor.description_zh: Head armor that looks ready to charge off one's head. Creates a small stink radius.

armor.name: F Arzuros Helm
armor.description: Head armor that was nearly discontinued after wearers were mistaken for Arzuros.
armor.description_de: Diesen Kopfschutz hätte man fast abgeschafft, weil man Träger für Arzuros hielt.
armor.description_fr: Ses porteurs étant souvent confondus avec Arzuros, sa production a failli cesser.
armor.description_es: Cayó en desuso porque confundían a sus portadores con auténticos Arzuros.
armor.description_it: Elmo quasi bandito per l'eccessiva somiglianza ai veri Arzuros.
armor.description_zh: Head armor that was nearly discontinued after wearers were mistaken for Arzuros.

armor.name: F Genprey Helm
armor.description: A soft, comfy cap that can be worn all sorts of ways, but best with one end up.
armor.description_de: Eine weiche, bequeme Kappe, die vielseitig tragbar ist, am besten mit einem Ende oben.
armor.description_fr: Calot doux et confortable, qui se porte de mille façons. Encore plus seyant avec un côté relevé.
armor.description_es: Una gorra suave, cómoda y muy versátil; recomendamos levantar un extremo.
armor.description_it: Cappello morbido indossabile in più modi, ma che rende al meglio con la punta all'insù.
armor.description_zh: A soft, comfy cap that can be worn all sorts of ways, but best with one end up.

armor.name: F Cephalos Hat
armor.description: Cephalos headwear with a scarlet ribbon. Full of hope (and food, if hope fails).
armor.description_de: Cephalos-Kopfbedeckung mit rotem Band. Voller Hoffnung (und wenn nötig auch Essen).
armor.description_fr: Couvre-chef Cephalos, à ruban écarlate. Porteur d'espoir (voire de nourriture, au besoin).
armor.description_es: Sombrero de Cephalos con cinta escarlata. Cargado de esperanza (¡y de comida!).
armor.description_it: Copricapo con nastro rosso. È carico di speranza (e cibo, se la speranza non è sufficiente).
armor.description_zh: Cephalos headwear with a scarlet ribbon. Full of hope (and food, if hope fails).

armor.name: F Stone Head
armor.description: A mask based on a statue the Meownster Hunters found. Feels positively ancient.
armor.description_de: Eine Maske nach einer von den Miaunster-Jägern gefundenen Statue. Fühlt sich steinalt an.
armor.description_fr: Masque qui s'inspire d'une statue antique trouvée par les Chasseurs de miaonstres.
armor.description_es: Inspirada en una estatua que encontraron los cazamiaunstruos. Parece muy antigua.
armor.description_it: Maschera ricavata da una statua ritrovata dai cacciatori di miaostri. Ha un aspetto antico.
armor.description_zh: A mask based on a statue the Meownster Hunters found. Feels positively ancient.

armor.name: F Venombee Cap
armor.description: For cool cats too rad to take their sunglasses off indoors, look no further.
armor.description_de: Ideal für alle, die zu cool sind, ihre Sonnenbrille drinnen abzusetzen.
armor.description_fr: Calot idéal pour ceux qui rechignent à retirer leurs lunettes de soleil à l'intérieur.
armor.description_es: Si no te quitas las gafas de sol ni para estar por casa, esto va a ser lo tuyo.
armor.description_it: L'accessorio ideale per i duri che non si sfilano gli occhiali da sole neppure al buio.
armor.description_zh: For cool cats too rad to take their sunglasses off indoors, look no further.

armor.name: F Gourmet Toque
armor.description: A chef's hat that matches that of the Gourmew Chef's, right down to its size.
armor.description_de: Eine Kochhaube wie die des Gourmiau-Kochs, sogar in derselben Größe.
armor.description_fr: Toque semblable en tout point à celle du célèbre chef Gourmiaou.
armor.description_es: Gorro de cocinero inspirado en el del Chef Gourmiáu hasta en la talla.
armor.description_it: Cappello da cuoco ispirato a quello dello chef Gourmiao, anche nelle dimensioni.
armor.description_zh: A chef's hat that matches that of the Gourmew Chef's, right down to its size.

armor.name: F Moofy Head
armor.description: A helmet that looks just like a baby Moofah. Long neck not included.
armor.description_de: Ein Helm, der wie ein Baby- Muufah aussieht. Langer Hals nicht inbegriffen.
armor.description_fr: Casque ressemblant à un bébé Moofah... sans son long cou.
armor.description_es: Casco que parece una cría de Moofah. No incluye cuello largo.
armor.description_it: Elmo che riproduce le fattezze di un cucciolo di Moofah, tranne il collo allungato.
armor.description_zh: A helmet that looks just like a baby Moofah. Long neck not included.

armor.name: F Aptonoth Mask
armor.description: While handy for Aptonoth cosplaying, this mask also protects the face well.
armor.description_de: Eine Maske zum Verkleiden als Aptonoth, die aber auch das Gesicht schützt.
armor.description_fr: Masque idéal pour se déguiser en Aptonoth, qui protège en outre très bien le visage.
armor.description_es: Para disfrazarse de Aptonoth. Además, protege la cara.
armor.description_it: Un perfetto travestimento da Aptonoth, nonché un'efficace protezione per il volto.
armor.description_zh: While handy for Aptonoth cosplaying, this mask also protects the face well.

armor.name: F Popo Head
armor.description: These handy tusks work well at scaring off potential predators on the prowl.
armor.description_de: Diese praktischen Hauer vertreiben problemlos umherstreifende Raubtiere.
armor.description_fr: Défenses très pratiques permettant d'effrayer d'éventuels prédateurs.
armor.description_es: Colmillos útiles para asustar a posibles depredadores que merodeen por ahí.
armor.description_it: Le sue zanne terranno alla larga i predatori alla ricerca di cibo.
armor.description_zh: These handy tusks work well at scaring off potential predators on the prowl.

armor.name: F Gargwa Mask
armor.description: A bird mask that whips up carnivores' appetites. Has high Dragon Resistance.
armor.description_de: Diese Vogelmaske regt den Appetit von Fleischfressern an. Hohe Drachenabwehr.
armor.description_fr: Masque d'oiseau qui donne faim aux carnivores. Bonne résistance aux dragons.
armor.description_es: Su forma de pájaro despierta el apetito a los carnívoros. Resistencia alta al draco.
armor.description_it: Maschera da uccello che attira i carnivori. Fornisce alta resistenza al drago.
armor.description_zh: A bird mask that whips up carnivores' appetites. Has high Dragon Resistance.

armor.name: F Ioprey Helm
armor.description: A hat that can't help but stand out. Ideal for playing pretend as a general.
armor.description_de: Ein Hut, der aus der Menge heraussticht. Ideal, um sich als General auszugeben.
armor.description_fr: Heaume impossible à ne pas remarquer, idéal pour jouer les généraux.
armor.description_es: Llamativo sombrero, ideal para fingir ser general.
armor.description_it: Copricapo che ti metterà al centro dell'attenzione. Ideale per fingersi un generale.
armor.description_zh: A hat that can't help but stand out. Ideal for playing pretend as a general.

armor.name: F Lagombi Helm
armor.description: Fur head armor that keeps the wearer's face warm even in sub-zero temperatures.
armor.description_de: Ein Pelz-Kopfschutz, der das Gesicht des Trägers selbst bei Minusgraden warm hält.
armor.description_fr: Casque en fourrure qui garde le visage au chaud même par des températures négatives.
armor.description_es: Armadura de cabeza de piel. Mantiene caliente la cara del portador.
armor.description_it: Elmo di pelliccia che tiene al caldo la testa anche alle basse temperature.
armor.description_zh: Fur head armor that keeps the wearer's face warm even in sub-zero temperatures.

armor.name: F Kut-Ku Mask
armor.description: A delightful take on the Yian Kut-Ku... Delightful, or just plain creepy.
armor.description_de: Die bezaubernde Variante des Yian Kut-Ku. Bezaubernd... oder auch einfach schräg.
armor.description_fr: S'inspire du Yian Kut-Ku. À la fois charmant et terrifiant.
armor.description_es: Una encantadora versión del Yian Kut-Ku... Encantadora o simplemente espeluznante.
armor.description_it: Un delizioso omaggio allo Yian Kut-Ku... Inquietante, più che delizioso.
armor.description_zh: A delightful take on the Yian Kut-Ku... Delightful, or just plain creepy.

armor.name: F Gypceros Crest
armor.description: August headwear with a wise gaze. The crest is said to glow when the gods return.
armor.description_de: Erhabene Kopfbedeckung mit weisem Blick. Der Kamm glüht bei der Rückkehr der Götter.
armor.description_fr: Masque auguste empreint de sagesse. Censé annoncer le retour des dieux.
armor.description_es: Prenda que da un aire de sabiduría. Dicen que brillará cuando regresen los dioses.
armor.description_it: Copricapo sontuoso che dona un'aria saggia. La cresta saluta raggiante il ritorno degli dei.
armor.description_zh: August headwear with a wise gaze. The crest is said to glow when the gods return.

armor.name: F Cabra Horn
armor.description: A beefy Tetsucabra horn and fluffy mane. Turns wearers into legendary fiends.
armor.description_de: Ein kräftiges Tetsucabra-Horn mit flauschiger Mähne. Macht aus Trägern wahre Unholde.
armor.description_fr: Corne à l'imposante crinière, qui fait de son porteur un adversaire de légende.
armor.description_es: Recio cuerno y suave crin de Tetsucabra. Su portador es un poderoso enemigo.
armor.description_it: Grosso corno di Tetsucabra con tanto di morbida criniera. Rende feroci come demoni.
armor.description_zh: A beefy Tetsucabra horn and fluffy mane. Turns wearers into legendary fiends.

armor.name: F Daimyo Mask
armor.description: Headwear made from red, durable plating. The Palico looks out through the mouth.
armor.description_de: Kopfbedeckung aus robusten roten Platten. Der Kamerad schaut durch den Mund heraus.
armor.description_fr: Solide masque de plaque rouge. Permet de voir à travers sa bouche.
armor.description_es: Prenda con una coraza roja y resistente. El camarada ve a través de la boca.
armor.description_it: Copricapo di corazza rossa. La feritoia per gli occhi si trova nella bocca.
armor.description_zh: Headwear made from red, durable plating. The Palico looks out through the mouth.

armor.name: F Ludroth Helm
armor.description: Solid head armor whose spongy Royal Ludroth bits boost Water Resistance.
armor.description_de: Schwammartiger Kopfschutz, dessen Königs-Ludroth-Teile Wasser abweisen.
armor.description_fr: À base d'éléments de Ludroth royal qui améliorent la résistance à l'eau.
armor.description_es: Yelmo con fragmentos de Ludroth Real que mejoran la resistencia al agua.
armor.description_it: Elmo robusto che protegge dall'acqua grazie alle parti spugnose di Ludroth reale.
armor.description_zh: Solid head armor whose spongy Royal Ludroth bits boost Water Resistance.

armor.name: F Khezu Cap
armor.description: Head armor that seems too cute to be Khezu. It's hard not to fall in love!
armor.description_de: Kopfschutz, der fast zu süß ist, um aus Khezu zu sein. Man muss ihn einfach lieben!
armor.description_fr: Semble trop mignon pour être à base de Khezu. Comment ne pas tomber sous le charme ?
armor.description_es: Bonita armadura de cabeza: no parece hecha de Khezu. ¡Imposible no enamorarse!
armor.description_it: Fin troppo grazioso per essere di Khezu. Non potrai non innamorartene!
armor.description_zh: Head armor that seems too cute to be Khezu. It's hard not to fall in love!

armor.name: F Nibel Helm
armor.description: Stealth head armor that prevents the climate from foiling Palico missions.
armor.description_de: Tarn-Kopfschutz, der das Klima abhält, Kameraden- Missionen zu sabotieren.
armor.description_fr: Casque de furtivité qui empêche le climat de déjouer les missions d'un compagnon.
armor.description_es: Casco furtivo que evita que el clima fastidie una misión de los camaradas.
armor.description_it: Elmo furtivo che impedisce al clima di ostacolare le missioni dei compagni.
armor.description_zh: Stealth head armor that prevents the climate from foiling Palico missions.

armor.name: F Scholarly Cap
armor.description: A cap matching the one the Wycademy Gal wears. It simply oozes intelligence.
armor.description_de: Eine Kappe wie die des Wykademie-Mädels. Versprüht ungemeine Intelligenz.
armor.description_fr: Calot assorti à celui porté par la Demoiselle de la Wycadémie. Donne l'air intelligent.
armor.description_es: Gorra como la que lleva la chica de la Wycademia. Exuda inteligencia.
armor.description_it: Simile al cappello indossato dalla dama della Wyccademia. Esprime intelligenza.
armor.description_zh: A cap matching the one the Wycademy Gal wears. It simply oozes intelligence.

armor.name: F Derring Galea
armor.description: Glamorous head armor for your Palico's debut. They can wear it with pride.
armor.description_de: Ein glamouröser Kopfschutz. Kameraden können ihn beim Debüt mit Stolz tragen.
armor.description_fr: Coiffe élégante pour les débuts de votre Palico. À porter avec fierté.
armor.description_es: Armadura de cabeza inicial sofisticada para tu camarada. Pueden llevarla con orgullo.
armor.description_it: Elmo alla moda per i compagni debuttanti. Li riempirà di orgoglio.
armor.description_zh: Glamorous head armor for your Palico's debut. They can wear it with pride.

armor.name: F Edel Pigtails
armor.description: These sweet-scented pigtails are a big hit with even the biggest monsters.
armor.description_de: Diese süß duftenden Zöpfe sind der Renner selbst bei den größten Monstern.
armor.description_fr: Couettes parfumées qui font tourner bien des têtes... même celle des monstres !
armor.description_es: Aromáticas colas de cerdo: un éxito hasta con los monstruos más grandes.
armor.description_it: Questi codini dal profumo zuccheroso addolciranno anche i mostri più feroci.
armor.description_zh: These sweet-scented pigtails are a big hit with even the biggest monsters.

armor.name: F Kittendant Hood
armor.description: A Flight Kittendant cap. Putting it on is sure to make passengers take notice!
armor.description_de: Eine Flug-Katzendanten- kappe. Wer sie trägt, fällt den Passagieren auf!
armor.description_fr: Capuchon de Miaôtesse qui attirera l'œil de plus d'un passager !
armor.description_es: Sombrero de gazafato. ¡Póntelo para llamar la atención de los pasajeros!
armor.description_it: Cappello da miaostess di volo. Senza alcun dubbio, attirerà l'attenzione dei passeggeri!
armor.description_zh: A Flight Kittendant cap. Putting it on is sure to make passengers take notice!

armor.name: F Mosgharl Hat
armor.description: A get-up rascal Felynes use to spook villagers. Turns out it makes good armor, too!
armor.description_de: Damit erschrecken die Felynen gerne Dorfbewohner. Eignet sich aber auch als Schutz!
armor.description_fr: Permet à la fois de protéger la tête et de faire peur aux villageois.
armor.description_es: Los Felyne más gamberros los usan para asustar a los aldeanos. Buena protección.
armor.description_it: I monelli Felyne lo usano per spaventare i compaesani. È anche un'ottima difesa!
armor.description_zh: A get-up rascal Felynes use to spook villagers. Turns out it makes good armor, too!

armor.name: F Larinoth Mask
armor.description: This mask's lofty face makes it impossible to tell where the wearer's eyes are.
armor.description_de: Das erhabene Gesicht dieser Maske verbirgt die Augen ihres Trägers voll und ganz.
armor.description_fr: Masque aux traits dédaigneux qui empêche de voir les yeux de son porteur.
armor.description_es: El rostro de esta máscara no permite saber dónde están los ojos del portador.
armor.description_it: La forma allungata di questa maschera nasconde gli occhi di chi la indossa.
armor.description_zh: This mask's lofty face makes it impossible to tell where the wearer's eyes are.

armor.name: F Death Stench Hood
armor.description: A hood so reminiscent of the grim reaper, passers-by make their peace.
armor.description_de: Eine Kapuze, die dem düsteren Sensenmann so gleicht, dass Passanten sich bekreuzigen.
armor.description_fr: Capuchon évoquant la Camarde et rappelant à tous que la vie ne tient qu'à un fil... Brr !
armor.description_es: Una capucha que recuerda tanto a la Parca que quienes la encuentran se confiesan.
armor.description_it: Cappuccio talmente simile a quello del triste mietitore da ammutolire i passanti.
armor.description_zh: A hood so reminiscent of the grim reaper, passers-by make their peace.

armor.name: F Marauder Helm
armor.description: The helm of a Felyne who sought to rule all. The paw- print boosts Palico morale.
armor.description_de: Der Helm einer Felyne, die alle beherrschen wollte. Der Abdruck fördert Kampfgeist.
armor.description_fr: Casque de Felyne aux grandes ambitions. L'empreinte de patte donne du courage.
armor.description_es: El casco de un Felyne que ansiaba gobernarlo todo. Las huellas suben la moral.
armor.description_it: Elmo di un Felyne bramoso di potere. La zampa solleva il morale dei compagni.
armor.description_zh: The helm of a Felyne who sought to rule all. The paw- print boosts Palico morale.

armor.name: F Volvi Helm
armor.description: Shell armor revered as a bearer of Fire. Sells out before every festival.
armor.description_de: Panzer-Schutz, verehrt als Träger des Feuers. Verkauft sich bestens vor Festivals.
armor.description_fr: Ce casque porteur de feu fait l'objet d'un culte. Souvent en rupture de stock.
armor.description_es: Armadura de caparazón del portador del fuego. Todos quieren una para el festival.
armor.description_it: Elmo di guscio posseduto dal fuoco. Va a ruba prima di ogni sagra.
armor.description_zh: Shell armor revered as a bearer of Fire. Sells out before every festival.

armor.name: F Malfestio Mask
armor.description: A mask made from Malfestio Scraps. Its eyes are more than a little eerie.
armor.description_de: Eine Maske aus Malfestio- Resten. Die Augen sind mehr als furchterregend.
armor.description_fr: Masque fabriqué à partir de débris Malfestio. Ses yeux sont plus qu'étranges.
armor.description_es: Máscara fabricada con restos de Malfestio. Sus ojos son terriblemente espeluznantes.
armor.description_it: Maschera ricavata da parti di Malfestio. Gli occhi sono decisamente inquietanti.
armor.description_zh: A mask made from Malfestio Scraps. Its eyes are more than a little eerie.

armor.name: F Rathian Helm
armor.description: A symbol of ferocity and pride that yields remarkable Defense and Fire Resistance.
armor.description_de: Ein Symbol von Wildheit und Stolz, mit bemerkenswerter Verteidigung u. Feuerabwehr.
armor.description_fr: Symbole de férocité dont la défense et la résistance au feu sont remarquables.
armor.description_es: Símbolo de ferocidad y de orgullo que aporta mucha defensa y resiste al fuego.
armor.description_it: Simbolo di orgoglio e ferocia che migliora difesa e resistenza al fuoco.
armor.description_zh: A symbol of ferocity and pride that yields remarkable Defense and Fire Resistance.

armor.name: F Blango Mask
armor.description: Dancing with this creepy mask on is thought to ward off evil spirits.
armor.description_de: Das Tanzen mit dieser gruseligen Maske soll böse Geister abwehren.
armor.description_fr: Masque terrifiant qui ferait fuir les mauvais esprits lorsque son porteur danse.
armor.description_es: Se supone que bailar con esta tétrica máscara puesta asusta a los malos espíritus.
armor.description_it: Chi danza con indosso questa orrenda maschera è in grado di scacciare gli spiriti maligni.
armor.description_zh: Dancing with this creepy mask on is thought to ward off evil spirits.

armor.name: F Ceanataur Mask
armor.description: The Shogun Ceanataur's angular head makes for a tight-fitting mask.
armor.description_de: Aus dem kantigen Kopf des Shogun Ceanataur wird eine eng anliegende Maske.
armor.description_fr: Masque très ajusté, fabriqué à partir de la tête anguleuse d'un Ceanataur Shogun.
armor.description_es: La cabeza angular del Shogun Ceanataur es una máscara que se ajusta como un guante.
armor.description_it: Maschera avvolgente ricavata dal cranio squadrato dello Shogun Ceanataur.
armor.description_zh: The Shogun Ceanataur's angular head makes for a tight-fitting mask.

armor.name: F Naja Turban
armor.description: A turban that makes Palicoes shout, "Come on! Snake my day!" Often ends in tragedy.
armor.description_de: Liegt schwer auf dem Kopf, wie das unsägliche Unge- heuer Leviathan.
armor.description_fr: Donne l'illusion de savoir charmer les serpents. Cause de nombreux accidents.
armor.description_es: Los camaradas al ponérselo gritan "¡Dejad las serpientes para mí!". Y todo acaba mal.
armor.description_it: Un turbante che fa esclamare ai compagni: "Ho un serpente per capello!".
armor.description_zh: A turban that makes Palicoes shout, "Come on! Snake my day!" Often ends in tragedy.

armor.name: F Narga Helm
armor.description: Head armor themed after the black garb of the East. Enables shadowy approaches.
armor.description_de: Kopfschutz im Stil des schwarzen Gewandes. Für schattenhaftes Vorgehen.
armor.description_fr: Inspiré de la tenue noire de l'Orient. Permet une approche furtive.
armor.description_es: Armadura de cabeza inspirada en vestimentas orientales. Te da un aire sombrío.
armor.description_it: Elmo ispirato alle nere vesti d'oriente. Agevola gli approcci furtivi.
armor.description_zh: Head armor themed after the black garb of the East. Enables shadowy approaches.

armor.name: F Maiden Hood
armor.description: A hood modeled after the Kokoto Gal, designed with big ears in mind.
armor.description_de: Eine Kapuze nach dem Vorbild des Kokoto-Mädels, für große Ohren entworfen.
armor.description_fr: Capuchon inspiré par la demoiselle Kokoto. Conçu pour les grandes oreilles.
armor.description_es: Capucha inspirada en la chica de Kokoto, diseñada para orejas grandes.
armor.description_it: Cappuccio ispirato alla dama di Kokoto, di cui riprende le grosse orecchie.
armor.description_zh: A hood modeled after the Kokoto Gal, designed with big ears in mind.

armor.name: F Helper Hood
armor.description: The tavern girl's hood refitted for Palicoes, right down to the last ornament.
armor.description_de: Die Kapuze des Tavernen- mädchens, mit Liebe zum Detail für Kameraden umgerüstet.
armor.description_fr: Capuchon de servante adapté aux Palicos dans ses moindres coutures.
armor.description_es: Capucha de tabernera adaptada a camaradas hasta el último detalle.
armor.description_it: Cappuccio per compagni che riproduce in ogni dettaglio quello della locandiera.
armor.description_zh: The tavern girl's hood refitted for Palicoes, right down to the last ornament.

armor.name: F Pretty Toque
armor.description: A Quest Counter favorite in Yukumo Village. Makes every hunter say, "Hire me!"
armor.description_de: Favorit am Quest-Schalter des Dorfs Yukumo. Lässt jeden Jäger "Heure mich an!" rufen.
armor.description_fr: Favori du Comptoir des quêtes de Yukumo. Favorise les contrats.
armor.description_es: Gusta mucho en el puesto de misiones de Yukumo. Hace que todos quieran contratarte.
armor.description_it: Un indumento indossato dal personale del banco missioni di Yukumo per attirare cacciatori.
armor.description_zh: A Quest Counter favorite in Yukumo Village. Makes every hunter say, "Hire me!"

armor.name: F Chaos Bulbs
armor.description: Be a vision -- or just see them -- with this beguiling 'shroom and ribbon headband.
armor.description_de: Sei eine Vision - oder sieh sie - dank diesem betörenden Pilz-und-Schleifen-Haarreif.
armor.description_fr: Envoûtante coiffe champi qui fait son effet.
armor.description_es: Sé una visión (o ten visiones) con esta encantadora diadema de champis y lazos.
armor.description_it: Fascia con funghi e nastrini di una bellezza allucinante... letteralmente.
armor.description_zh: Be a vision -- or just see them -- with this beguiling 'shroom and ribbon headband.

armor.name: F El Dora Helm
armor.description: Any Palico would be proud to wear this feathered Meownster Hunter treasure.
armor.description_de: Jeder Kamerad würde den ge- fiederten Schatz der Miaunster- Jäger mit Stolz tragen.
armor.description_fr: Relique à plumes d'un Chasseur de miaonstres que tout Palico serait fier de porter.
armor.description_es: Todo camarada llevaría con orgullo este tesoro emplumado de los cazamiaunstruos.
armor.description_it: Qualunque compagno vorrebbe indossare questo tesoro piumato dei cacciatori di miaostri.
armor.description_zh: Any Palico would be proud to wear this feathered Meownster Hunter treasure.

armor.name: F Artian Core
armor.description: A highly sturdy Palico helm made from a mysterious mined metal.
armor.description_de: Sehr robuster Kameradenhelm aus einem geheimnisvollen in den Minen abgebauten Metall.
armor.description_fr: Solide heaume de Palico, fabriqué dans un métal mystérieux.
armor.description_es: Casco de camarada muy recio, fabricado con algún tipo de metal misterioso.
armor.description_it: Elmo per compagni molto robusto ricavato da un misterioso minerale.
armor.description_zh: A highly sturdy Palico helm made from a mysterious mined metal.

armor.name: F Garuga Hood
armor.description: Sage headwear that a foreign tactician might wear. Not your standard Palico hairdo!
armor.description_de: Weise Kopfbedeckung eines fremdländischen Taktikers. Extravaganz für Kameraden!
armor.description_fr: Masque digne d'un tacticien étranger. Coiffe de Palico plutôt originale.
armor.description_es: Gorro de sabio propio de un estratega extranjero. ¡Tu camarada parecerá otra cosa!
armor.description_it: Simbolo di saggezza di uno stratega straniero. Insolito per un compagno.
armor.description_zh: Sage headwear that a foreign tactician might wear. Not your standard Palico hairdo!

armor.name: F Uragaan Helm
armor.description: Unparalleled head defense, but it makes reading your Palico's mood a chore.
armor.description_de: Unübertroffener Kopfschutz. Nur die Laune des Kameraden ist schwer zu erkennen.
armor.description_fr: D'une efficacité hors pair, mais rend l'humeur de votre Palico indéchiffrable.
armor.description_es: Otorga una defensa sin par, pero dificulta saber el estado de ánimo del camarada.
armor.description_it: È un'ottima difesa, ma nasconderà anche le emozioni del tuo compagno.
armor.description_zh: Unparalleled head defense, but it makes reading your Palico's mood a chore.

armor.name: F Rathalos Helm
armor.description: Head armor as wild and regal as the King of the Skies. Quiets the fiercest of Fire.
armor.description_de: Kopfschutz, majestätisch wie der König der Lüfte. Dämmt selbst wildestes Feuer ein.
armor.description_fr: Aussi sauvage et royal que le roi des cieux. Étouffe le plus violent des feux.
armor.description_es: Casco salvaje y regio como el mismo rey de los cielos. Sofoca cualquier fuego.
armor.description_it: Elmo feroce e regale come il re dei cieli. Estingue anche le fiamme più ardenti.
armor.description_zh: Head armor as wild and regal as the King of the Skies. Quiets the fiercest of Fire.

armor.name: F Lagia Tricorne
armor.description: A pirate hat that unleashes a Palico's inner buccaneer. Tends to sell out quickly.
armor.description_de: Piratenhut, der den Freibeuter im Kameraden zum Vorschein bringt. Verkaufsschlager.
armor.description_fr: Révèle l'âme de pirate de votre Palico. Beaucoup de succès en magasin.
armor.description_es: Un sombrero pirata que libera al bucanero interior de todo camarada. Es muy popular.
armor.description_it: Cappello da pirata che esalta il lato piratesco dei compagni. È molto venduto.
armor.description_zh: A pirate hat that unleashes a Palico's inner buccaneer. Tends to sell out quickly.

armor.name: F Astalos Mask
armor.description: The crevices in this mask allow Palicoes to both see and breathe in it.
armor.description_de: Durch die Spalten in dieser Maske können Kameraden sehen und atmen.
armor.description_fr: Masque dont les fentes permettent aux Palicos de voir et respirer.
armor.description_es: Las grietas de la máscara permiten a los camaradas ver y respirar.
armor.description_it: I fori presenti sulla maschera permettono ai compagni di vedere e respirare.
armor.description_zh: The crevices in this mask allow Palicoes to both see and breathe in it.

armor.name: F Gammoth Collar
armor.description: This collar is so insulated that the heat it retains travels the whole body.
armor.description_de: Dieser Kragen ist so isoliert, dass die gespeicherte Wärme den ganzen Körper durchfließt.
armor.description_fr: Col protégeant si bien son porteur qu'il réchauffe son corps tout entier.
armor.description_es: Este cuello aísla tanto que el calor que retiene llega a todo el cuerpo.
armor.description_it: Questo collare è talmente ermetico che trasmette al corpo il calore di cui è pervaso.
armor.description_zh: This collar is so insulated that the heat it retains travels the whole body.

armor.name: F Mizutsune Kasa
armor.description: The distinct conical hat and fetching mask make this a hit at festivals.
armor.description_de: Dank besonderem Hut in Kegelform und reizender Maske ein Festivalhit.
armor.description_fr: Chapeau conique distinctif, au masque assorti, qui fait son effet lors des festivals.
armor.description_es: El clásico sombrero cónico y la llamativa máscara hacen que triunfe en festivales.
armor.description_it: Il cappello a cono e la maschera accattivante sono perfetti per le feste.
armor.description_zh: The distinct conical hat and fetching mask make this a hit at festivals.

armor.name: F Guild Headgear
armor.description: Guild-order armor given only to pure hearts who have sworn to help those in need.
armor.description_de: Rüstung in Gildenqualität, reserviert für edelmütige Helfer in der Not.
armor.description_fr: Remise uniquement aux cœurs purs ayant juré de défendre les plus faibles.
armor.description_es: Armadura del gremio que se da a los puros de corazón que ayudan a los necesitados.
armor.description_it: Elmo della Gilda consegnato solo a chi si impegna ad aiutare chi è in difficoltà.
armor.description_zh: Guild-order armor given only to pure hearts who have sworn to help those in need.

armor.name: F Glavenus Helm
armor.description: This helm was forged in such high heat, it'd likely withstand the flames of hell itself.
armor.description_de: Der bei hohen Temperaturen geschmiedete Helm würde wohl selbst Fegefeuer standhalten.
armor.description_fr: Heaume forgé dans une telle fournaise qu'il résisterait même au feu de l'enfer.
armor.description_es: Este casco se forjó con tanto calor que resistiría hasta las llamas del infierno.
armor.description_it: La forgiatura ad altissime temperature gli permette di resistere anche alle fiamme.
armor.description_zh: This helm was forged in such high heat, it'd likely withstand the flames of hell itself.

armor.name: F Zinogre Helm
armor.description: Head armor that makes every living thing shrink away. Unlock the inner behemoth.
armor.description_de: Kopfschutz, vor dem alles zurückschreckt, was lebt. Erwecke den Koloss in dir.
armor.description_fr: Fait fuir d'effroi tout être vivant. Révèle le béhémoth en chacun de nous.
armor.description_es: Casco que espanta a todo ser vivo. Libera con él a tu titán interior.
armor.description_it: Mette in fuga qualunque creatura. Libera il mostro che è in te.
armor.description_zh: Head armor that makes every living thing shrink away. Unlock the inner behemoth.

armor.name: F Gore Horror
armor.description: Head armor worn during the Magala eclipse. The wearer must face burning despair.
armor.description_de: Kopfschutz, getragen bei der Magala-Finsternis. Ursache brennender Verzweiflung.
armor.description_fr: Portée lors de l'éclipse de Magala. Son porteur est la proie d'un désespoir ardent.
armor.description_es: Armadura de cabeza llevada durante el eclipse de Magala. Para enfrentarse al horror.
armor.description_it: Elmo indossato durante l'eclissi del Magala. Induce una cocente disperazione.
armor.description_zh: Head armor worn during the Magala eclipse. The wearer must face burning despair.

armor.name: F Seregios Helm
armor.description: Head armor made of shining Seregios plates. The gleaming blades promise victory.
armor.description_de: Kopfschutz aus glänzenden Seregios-Platten. Die Klingen versprechen den Sieg.
armor.description_fr: Casque en plaques luisantes de Seregios. Ses lames sont une promesse de victoire.
armor.description_es: Casco hecho con la brillante coraza de un Seregios. Para hacerse con la victoria.
armor.description_it: Elmo con placche scintillanti di Seregios. Le lame abbaglianti sono garanzia di vittoria.
armor.description_zh: Head armor made of shining Seregios plates. The gleaming blades promise victory.

armor.name: F Tigrex Helm
armor.description: A symbol of the Tigrex's vindictive nature. May even bite the wearer's hand.
armor.description_de: Ein Symbol des Rachedurstes des Tigrex. Beißt eventuell dem Träger in die Hand.
armor.description_fr: Symbole de la nature vindicative du Tigrex. Peut même mordre son porteur.
armor.description_es: Símbolo de la naturaleza rencorosa del Tigrex. Puede llegar a morder al portador.
armor.description_it: Simbolo della natura vendicativa del Tigrex. Attenzione, morde!
armor.description_zh: A symbol of the Tigrex's vindictive nature. May even bite the wearer's hand.

armor.name: F Kirin Horn
armor.description: The Palico Kirin equipment hunters have clamored for. Wear the horn with pride!
armor.description_de: Kirin-Kameraden-Ausrüstung, die Jäger schon immer wollten. Trage es mit Stolz!
armor.description_fr: Pièce d'armure de Kirin tant attendue par les chasseurs. Portez-la avec fierté !
armor.description_es: El equipo Kirin de camarada que pedían los cazadores. ¡Lleva el cuerno con orgullo!
armor.description_it: Elmo di Kirin per compagni apprezzato dai cacciatori. Indossalo con orgoglio!
armor.description_zh: The Palico Kirin equipment hunters have clamored for. Wear the horn with pride!

armor.name: F Brachy Headgear
armor.description: Knockout headgear for would- be pugilists. Turn your Palico into a contender!
armor.description_de: K.-o.-Kopfbedeckung für angehende Boxer. Macht einen Kameraden zum Kämpfer!
armor.description_fr: Idéale pour les pugilistes en herbe. Faites de votre compagnon un champion !
armor.description_es: Cubrecabeza para púgiles aficionados. ¡Convierte a tu camarada en todo un campeón!
armor.description_it: Copricapo per aspiranti pugili. Trasforma il tuo compagno in un campione!
armor.description_zh: Knockout headgear for would- be pugilists. Turn your Palico into a contender!

armor.name: F Angel Halo
armor.description: Head armor worn at the gods' resurrection. Wearers witness the light of hope.
armor.description_de: Kopfschmuck für die Aufer- stehung der Götter. Betrach- te das Licht der Hoffnung.
armor.description_fr: Portée lors de la résurrection des dieux. Son porteur est empli d'espoir.
armor.description_es: Armadura de cabeza llevada durante la resurrección de los dioses. Da esperanza.
armor.description_it: Elmo indossato durante la resurrezione degli dei. Porta un lume di speranza.
armor.description_zh: Head armor worn at the gods' resurrection. Wearers witness the light of hope.

armor.name: F Kushala Glare
armor.description: Head armor that honors the god of the moon and harvest. Brings blessings and glory.
armor.description_de: Ein Kopfschutz, der den Gott des Mondes und der Ernte ehrt. Bringt Segen und Ruhm.
armor.description_fr: Honore le dieu de la lune et de la moisson. Apporte gloire et bénédiction.
armor.description_es: Armadura de cabeza que honra al dios de la luna y la cosecha. Trae bendiciones para todos.
armor.description_it: Elmo che onora il dio della luna e del raccolto. Porta gioia e benedizione.
armor.description_zh: Head armor that honors the god of the moon and harvest. Brings blessings and glory.

armor.name: F Genie Helm
armor.description: Head armor imbued with mystic Chameleos power. Helps one grant their master's wishes.
armor.description_de: Erfüllt von mystischer Chame- leos-Macht. Hilft, Wünsche des Meisters zu erfüllen.
armor.description_fr: Casque imprégné d'un pouvoir mystique. Aide à exaucer les vœux de son maître.
armor.description_es: Casco con el poder místico del Chameleos. Ayuda al portador a cumplir con su amo.
armor.description_it: Elmo con il potere mistico del Chameleos. Aiuta a eseguire gli ordini del proprio signore.
armor.description_zh: Head armor imbued with mystic Chameleos power. Helps one grant their master's wishes.

armor.name: F Kaiser Periwig
armor.description: Noble Teostra wear. Golden locks? Check. Regal crown? Check. Sterling rep? Check!
armor.description_de: Edle Teostra-Mode. Güldene Locken, Königskrone, erstklassiger Ruf, alles da!
armor.description_fr: À base de Teostra. La totale : boucles dorées, couronne et réputation.
armor.description_es: Accesorio noble de Teostra. Con rizos dorados, corona y pundonor, ¡el pack completo!
armor.description_it: Nobile copricapo di Teostra. Boccoli d'oro, corona regale, blasone... Ha tutto.
armor.description_zh: Noble Teostra wear. Golden locks? Check. Regal crown? Check. Sterling rep? Check!

armor.name: F Husk Mask
armor.description: Beneath this perturbing mask that's gone to hell and back lies a lost Palico soul.
armor.description_de: Die beunruhigende Maske ist aus der Hölle zurück und birgt eine verlorene Kameradenseele.
armor.description_fr: Masque effrayant qui semble tout droit sorti des enfers. Abrite l'âme perdue d'un Palico.
armor.description_es: Una máscara perturbadora que ha viajado al infierno, con alma de camarada.
armor.description_it: In questa maschera inquietante riemersa dall'inferno alberga l'anima di un compagno.
armor.description_zh: Beneath this perturbing mask that's gone to hell and back lies a lost Palico soul.

armor.name: F Acorn Helm S
armor.description: Entry-level Felyne Palico head armor. The look that defined a generation!
armor.description_de: Felyne-Kameraden-Kopfschutz für Einsteiger. Der Look einer ganzen Generation!
armor.description_fr: Coiffe Felyne basique pour Palico. Le style de toute une génération !
armor.description_es: Armadura de cabeza básica de los camaradas Felyne. ¡Típica de toda una generación!
armor.description_it: Elmo di base per compagni Felyne. Il suo stile ha fatto epoca!
armor.description_zh: Entry-level Felyne Palico head armor. The look that defined a generation!

armor.name: F Bherna Hood S
armor.description: A hat that snugly swaddles the head in protective fabrics. Great for highland work.
armor.description_de: Ein Hut, dessen Stoff den Kopf schützend umhüllt. Ideal für Hochland-Arbeit.
armor.description_fr: Chapeau couvrant la tête de tissus protecteurs. Idéal pour les missions en plaine.
armor.description_es: Un gorro que envuelve la cabeza en tejido protector. Ideal para zonas montañosas.
armor.description_it: Pratico copricapo avvolgente in tessuto protettivo. Ideale per le attività montane.
armor.description_zh: A hat that snugly swaddles the head in protective fabrics. Great for highland work.

armor.name: F Hunting Helm S
armor.description: Kokoto's iconic headgear, retrofitted for Palico use. Conveys an old-school vibe.
armor.description_de: Kokotos Kult-Kopfbedeckung, umgerüstet für Kameraden. Da kommt Nostalgie auf.
armor.description_fr: Couvre-chef emblématique de Kokoto, adapté à vos Palicos. Il fait très "vieille école".
armor.description_es: Icónico casco de Kokoto, ajustado para camaradas. Tiene un aire muy clásico.
armor.description_it: Copricapo tipico di Kokoto, adattato ai compagni. Per chi ama lo stile classico.
armor.description_zh: Kokoto's iconic headgear, retrofitted for Palico use. Conveys an old-school vibe.

armor.name: F Mafumofu Hood S
armor.description: Specially made head armor from snowy Pokke Village. Felynes love its warm, fluffy feel.
armor.description_de: Spezial-Kopfschutz aus dem verschneiten Dorf Pokke. Die Felynen lieben seine Wärme.
armor.description_fr: Confectionné dans le village Pokke. Chaud et moelleux, les Felynes en raffolent.
armor.description_es: Armadura de cabeza típica de Pokke. A los Felyne les encanta el calorcito que da.
armor.description_it: Elmo speciale del nevoso villaggio di Pokke. I Felyne ne adorano la morbidezza.
armor.description_zh: Specially made head armor from snowy Pokke Village. Felynes love its warm, fluffy feel.

armor.name: F Yukumo Kasa S
armor.description: Head armor fashioned from Yukumo wood and bark. Don't leave home without it!
armor.description_de: Kopfschutz aus Yukumo-Holz und -Rinde. Niemals ohne aus dem Haus gehen!
armor.description_fr: À base de bois et d'écorce de Yukumo. Ne partez pas chasser sans lui !
armor.description_es: Armadura de cabeza hecha con madera y corteza de Yukumo. ¡No salgas de casa sin ella!
armor.description_it: Copricapo ricavato da legno e corteccia di Yukumo. Non uscire mai senza!
armor.description_zh: Head armor fashioned from Yukumo wood and bark. Don't leave home without it!

armor.name: F Gourmet Toque S
armor.description: A chef's hat that matches that of the Gourmew Chef's, right down to its size.
armor.description_de: Eine Kochhaube wie die des Gourmiau-Kochs, sogar in derselben Größe.
armor.description_fr: Toque semblable en tout point à celle du célèbre chef Gourmiaou.
armor.description_es: Gorro de cocinero inspirado en el del Chef Gourmiáu hasta en la talla.
armor.description_it: Cappello da cuoco ispirato a quello dello chef Gourmiao, anche nelle dimensioni.
armor.description_zh: A chef's hat that matches that of the Gourmew Chef's, right down to its size.

armor.name: F Moofy Head S
armor.description: A helmet that looks just like a baby Moofah. Long neck not included.
armor.description_de: Ein Helm, der wie ein Baby- Muufah aussieht. Langer Hals nicht inbegriffen.
armor.description_fr: Casque ressemblant à un bébé Moofah... sans son long cou.
armor.description_es: Casco que parece una cría de Moofah. No incluye cuello largo.
armor.description_it: Elmo che riproduce le fattezze di un cucciolo di Moofah, tranne il collo allungato.
armor.description_zh: A helmet that looks just like a baby Moofah. Long neck not included.

armor.name: F Aptonoth Mask S
armor.description: While handy for Aptonoth cosplaying, this mask also protects the face well.
armor.description_de: Eine Maske zum Verkleiden als Aptonoth, die aber auch das Gesicht schützt.
armor.description_fr: Masque idéal pour se déguiser en Aptonoth, qui protège en outre très bien le visage.
armor.description_es: Para disfrazarse de Aptonoth. Además, protege la cara.
armor.description_it: Un perfetto travestimento da Aptonoth, nonché un'efficace protezione per il volto.
armor.description_zh: While handy for Aptonoth cosplaying, this mask also protects the face well.

armor.name: F Popo Head S
armor.description: These handy tusks work well at scaring off potential predators on the prowl.
armor.description_de: Diese praktischen Hauer vertreiben problemlos umherstreifende Raubtiere.
armor.description_fr: Défenses très pratiques permettant d'effrayer d'éventuels prédateurs.
armor.description_es: Colmillos útiles para asustar a posibles depredadores que merodeen por ahí.
armor.description_it: Le sue zanne terranno alla larga i predatori alla ricerca di cibo.
armor.description_zh: These handy tusks work well at scaring off potential predators on the prowl.

armor.name: F Gargwa Mask S
armor.description: A bird mask that whips up carnivores' appetites. Has high Dragon Resistance.
armor.description_de: Diese Vogelmaske regt den Appetit von Fleischfressern an. Hohe Drachenabwehr.
armor.description_fr: Masque d'oiseau qui donne faim aux carnivores. Bonne résistance aux dragons.
armor.description_es: Su forma de pájaro despierta el apetito a los carnívoros. Resistencia alta al draco.
armor.description_it: Maschera da uccello che attira i carnivori. Fornisce alta resistenza al drago.
armor.description_zh: A bird mask that whips up carnivores' appetites. Has high Dragon Resistance.

armor.name: F Larinoth Mask S
armor.description: This mask's lofty face makes it impossible to tell where the wearer's eyes are.
armor.description_de: Das erhabene Gesicht dieser Maske verbirgt die Augen ihres Trägers voll und ganz.
armor.description_fr: Masque aux traits dédaigneux qui empêche de voir les yeux de son porteur.
armor.description_es: El rostro de esta máscara no permite saber dónde están los ojos del portador.
armor.description_it: La forma allungata di questa maschera nasconde gli occhi di chi la indossa.
armor.description_zh: This mask's lofty face makes it impossible to tell where the wearer's eyes are.

armor.name: F Alloy Helm S
armor.description: A product of quality ore and three nights of labor. Guaranteed head protection.
armor.description_de: Gefertigt aus Edelerz in drei arbeitsreichen Nächten. Kopfschutz garantiert.
armor.description_fr: Casque en alliage de qualité, qui a nécessité trois nuits de dur labeur et protège bien la tête.
armor.description_es: Un producto de metal de calidad y tres días de trabajo. Su cabeza, a salvo.
armor.description_it: Forgiato con metalli di qualità in tre notti di lavoro. Assicura protezione alla testa.
armor.description_zh: A product of quality ore and three nights of labor. Guaranteed head protection.

armor.name: F Bone Helm S
armor.description: Head armor made out of a monster skull. Awakens a Palico's wild side.
armor.description_de: Kopfschutz aus einem Monsterschädel. Weckt die Wildheit in jedem Kameraden.
